observation_summary: Superpositions evolve smoothly by the Schrodinger equation until measured; then a single definite outcome appears, with no equation describing the transition
why_it_resists_explanation: The theory contains two incompatible dynamical laws (unitary evolution and collapse) and no criterion specifying when one gives way to the other
leading_hypotheses: Many-worlds / Everett relative state; objective collapse (GRW, Penrose OR); pilot wave (de Broglie-Bohm); QBism and epistemic readings; decoherence plus branch selection
mainstream_view: Accepted as the deepest unresolved conceptual problem in physics; predictions work perfectly, interpretation does not
testable_prediction: Objective collapse models predict tiny spontaneous heating and gravitational decoherence detectable in large mechanical oscillators
key_evidence_or_cases: Double-slit with single particles; Stern-Gerlach; delayed-choice experiments; macroscopic superpositions up to 2000-atom molecules
notable_names: Bohr; Einstein; Everett; Bell; Zurek; Penrose
implication_if_solved: Would fix the ontology of physical reality and possibly reveal a deeper layer beneath quantum mechanics

observation_summary: Probability equals the squared modulus of the amplitude, a postulate no derivation has made uncontroversially inevitable
why_it_resists_explanation: Any derivation must assume something probability-like, making arguments circular; in many-worlds all branches occur so probability needs reinterpretation
leading_hypotheses: Decision-theoretic derivation (Deutsch-Wallace); envariance (Zurek); Gleason theorem as structural constraint; Born rule as brute postulate
mainstream_view: Widely regarded as unsolved even by many-worlds supporters
testable_prediction: Deviations from exact squared-modulus would show up as tiny nonlinearities in interference visibility
key_evidence_or_cases: Quantum tomography across all platforms confirms the rule to extreme precision
implication_if_solved: Would explain why probability exists in a deterministic wave equation

observation_summary: Measurement correlations violate Bell inequalities, exceeding any explanation by shared prior information, yet transmit no signal
why_it_resists_explanation: No mechanism is known that produces the correlations; locality, realism, or measurement independence must be abandoned and nothing selects which
leading_hypotheses: Nonlocal hidden variables; many-worlds (no collapse so no nonlocal action); retrocausality; superdeterminism; information-theoretic axioms
mainstream_view: Experimentally settled as fact; its mechanism is unexplained. 2022 Nobel Prize awarded for the experiments
testable_prediction: Any signaling or faster-than-light influence would be detectable; none found to date
key_evidence_or_cases: Aspect 1982; Zeilinger loophole-free tests 2015; Big Bell Test 2018; 1200 km satellite entanglement (Micius)
implication_if_solved: Would clarify whether space-time is fundamental or emergent from entanglement

observation_summary: Particles appear on the far side of barriers they lack the energy to cross, and measurements suggest the traverse can appear superluminal
why_it_resists_explanation: Time is not an observable with a Hermitian operator in quantum mechanics, so there is no agreed definition of how long tunneling takes
leading_hypotheses: Larmor clock timing; Wigner phase time; weak-value definitions; claim that the question is ill-posed
mainstream_view: Effect fully real and technologically exploited; duration remains definitionally contested
testable_prediction: Attoclock and Larmor-clock measurements should converge on one value as precision improves
key_evidence_or_cases: Hartman effect; 2020 Larmor clock measurement in rubidium; attosecond ionization experiments
implication_if_solved: Would sharpen the notion of time in quantum theory

phenomenon: Arrow of time and the low-entropy past
observation_summary: Microphysical laws are nearly time-symmetric, yet entropy increases in one direction, which traces back to an extraordinarily low-entropy initial state
why_it_resists_explanation: Explaining the initial condition requires a theory of initial conditions, which standard physics does not provide; anthropic selection is unsatisfying to most
leading_hypotheses: Past hypothesis as brute fact; Penrose Weyl curvature hypothesis; inflation smoothing; two-time-direction cosmologies (Carroll-Chen); gravitational entropy arguments
mainstream_view: Recognized as a genuine unexplained asymmetry at the foundation of thermodynamics
testable_prediction: Specific initial-condition hypotheses predict distinguishable primordial gravitational-wave and CMB signatures
key_evidence_or_cases: CMB uniformity to 1 part in 100000; observed monotonic entropy growth; absence of anti-thermodynamic processes
implication_if_solved: Would explain why the past differs from the future and why memory and causation point one way

observation_summary: Matter vastly outnumbers antimatter, roughly one excess baryon per billion photons, but the Big Bang should have produced equal amounts
why_it_resists_explanation: Known CP violation in the Standard Model is orders of magnitude too small to generate the observed asymmetry
leading_hypotheses: Electroweak baryogenesis with new CP phases; leptogenesis via heavy neutrino decay; Affleck-Dine mechanism; CPT-violating scenarios
mainstream_view: A central unsolved problem; strongly motivates searches for new CP violation
testable_prediction: New CP-violating phases should appear in neutrino oscillations or electric dipole moments
key_evidence_or_cases: CMB baryon density; Big Bang nucleosynthesis abundances; absence of antimatter galaxies; kaon and B-meson CP violation
implication_if_solved: Would explain why matter exists at all

observation_summary: Gravitational effects far exceeding visible mass appear in rotation curves, lensing, cluster dynamics and structure formation, with no detected particle
why_it_resists_explanation: Decades of direct detection, collider and indirect searches have found nothing, while modified-gravity alternatives fail on cluster and CMB scales
leading_hypotheses: WIMPs; axions; sterile neutrinos; primordial black holes; self-interacting dark matter; modified gravity (MOND, emergent gravity) as partial alternative
mainstream_view: Overwhelming consensus that the gravitational anomaly is real; identity entirely unknown
testable_prediction: Axion haloscopes and next-generation xenon detectors should see signals or exclude the remaining favored parameter space
key_evidence_or_cases: Zwicky cluster masses 1933; Rubin and Ford rotation curves 1970s; Bullet Cluster lensing-gas offset; CMB acoustic peaks; Lyman-alpha forest
implication_if_solved: Would reveal roughly a quarter of the energy content of the universe

observation_summary: Cosmic expansion is accelerating, as if driven by a uniform negative-pressure component making up about 68 percent of the energy density
why_it_resists_explanation: Quantum field theory predicts a vacuum energy up to 120 orders of magnitude larger than observed, the worst quantitative prediction in physics
leading_hypotheses: Cosmological constant; quintessence scalar fields; modified gravity; backreaction of inhomogeneities; anthropic multiverse selection
mainstream_view: Acceleration accepted (2011 Nobel Prize); cause completely unknown
testable_prediction: Evolving equation of state would be detectable by DESI, Euclid and Roman; DESI 2024-2025 data hint at evolution
key_evidence_or_cases: High-z supernovae 1998; CMB plus BAO; DESI DR2 dynamical dark energy hints
implication_if_solved: Would determine the fate of the universe and the nature of vacuum energy

locus: Local versus early universe expansion rate
observation_summary: Direct distance-ladder measurements give about 73 km/s/Mpc while CMB-based inference gives about 67, a persistent 5-sigma discrepancy
why_it_resists_explanation: Both measurement chains have been scrutinized exhaustively and no single systematic error accounts for the gap
leading_hypotheses: Unknown systematics in Cepheid or supernova calibration; early dark energy; extra relativistic species; evolving dark energy; new recombination physics
mainstream_view: Taken seriously as possible evidence of physics beyond the standard cosmological model
testable_prediction: JWST-calibrated distance ladders and gravitational-wave standard sirens should independently adjudicate
key_evidence_or_cases: SH0ES Cepheid program; Planck 2018; JWST confirmation of Cepheid photometry; TRGB and megamaser cross-checks
implication_if_solved: Could be the first clear crack in the standard cosmological model

locus: First fraction of a second after the Big Bang
observation_summary: Flatness, horizon uniformity and the spectrum of primordial fluctuations fit a brief epoch of exponential expansion, but no inflaton field has been identified
why_it_resists_explanation: The framework is so flexible that many models fit the data; there is no connection to known particle physics and no direct signature yet
leading_hypotheses: Single-field slow-roll inflation; Starobinsky R-squared; Higgs inflation; alternatives such as bouncing cosmologies and string gas cosmology
mainstream_view: Dominant paradigm but widely acknowledged as under-determined by data
testable_prediction: Detection of primordial B-mode polarization at measurable tensor-to-scalar ratio would confirm the energy scale
key_evidence_or_cases: CMB scale-invariant nearly-Gaussian fluctuations; spatial flatness; absence of monopoles; BICEP/Keck limits on r
implication_if_solved: Would pin the physics of the universe at energies a trillion times beyond colliders

observation_summary: Hawking radiation appears thermal and featureless, implying information about what fell in is destroyed, which quantum mechanics forbids
why_it_resists_explanation: Reconciling the two requires a quantum theory of gravity and the breakdown of semiclassical spacetime at some scale nobody can specify
leading_hypotheses: Information escapes in subtle correlations; islands and the Page curve from replica wormholes; firewalls; remnants; complementarity; ER equals EPR
mainstream_view: Recent island-formula work is widely seen as major progress but not a complete resolution
testable_prediction: Microstate counting should reproduce Bekenstein-Hawking entropy for all black holes, not just supersymmetric ones
key_evidence_or_cases: Hawking 1975 calculation; Strominger-Vafa entropy count; AdS/CFT; Page curve derivations 2019-2020
implication_if_solved: Would be a direct window into quantum gravity

locus: Black hole interiors and the Big Bang
observation_summary: General relativity predicts points where curvature and density diverge and the theory stops making predictions
why_it_resists_explanation: Gravity resists quantization: perturbative treatments are non-renormalizable and there is no experimental data at the Planck scale
leading_hypotheses: String/M-theory; loop quantum gravity; asymptotic safety; causal dynamical triangulations; emergent gravity from entanglement
mainstream_view: Universally agreed to be the biggest open problem in theoretical physics
testable_prediction: Candidate theories predict different Lorentz-violation bounds, black hole echoes, or primordial spectra
key_evidence_or_cases: Penrose-Hawking singularity theorems; Event Horizon Telescope images; LIGO ringdown data
implication_if_solved: Would unify all known physics

observation_summary: The Higgs mass is 125 GeV while quantum corrections should naturally drive it toward the Planck scale 17 orders of magnitude higher
why_it_resists_explanation: Requires either enormous fine-tuned cancellation or new physics that the LHC has not found
leading_hypotheses: Supersymmetry; technicolor and composite Higgs; extra dimensions; relaxion; cosmological selection; naturalness is simply not a valid principle
mainstream_view: A genuine theoretical puzzle; favored solutions are under increasing experimental pressure
testable_prediction: Superpartners or composite structure should appear at higher-luminosity or higher-energy colliders
key_evidence_or_cases: Higgs discovery 2012; null supersymmetry searches to multi-TeV; electroweak precision fits
implication_if_solved: Would explain why the weak scale and gravity scale differ so wildly

observation_summary: QCD permits a CP-violating term that should give the neutron a large electric dipole moment, yet experiment bounds it below one part in ten billion of the natural value
why_it_resists_explanation: No symmetry in the Standard Model forbids the term, so its near-perfect absence is unexplained
leading_hypotheses: Peccei-Quinn symmetry with an axion; spontaneous CP violation; massless up quark (excluded); anthropic selection
mainstream_view: Standard motivation for axion searches, which double as dark matter candidates
testable_prediction: Axion haloscopes (ADMX, ABRACADABRA, MADMAX) should find a signal in the microelectronvolt range
key_evidence_or_cases: nEDM experimental limits; lattice QCD topological susceptibility
implication_if_solved: Would likely identify dark matter simultaneously

observation_summary: The measured muon magnetic moment has long sat above Standard Model prediction, hinting at unknown virtual particles
why_it_resists_explanation: The theoretical prediction depends on hadronic vacuum polarization, where lattice QCD and data-driven methods disagree with each other
leading_hypotheses: New gauge bosons; supersymmetry; leptoquarks; or simply an incorrect hadronic contribution with no new physics
mainstream_view: Experiment is now extremely precise; the anomaly may be dissolving as theory consensus shifts toward lattice values
testable_prediction: Improved lattice and MUonE measurements will decide whether a deviation survives
key_evidence_or_cases: Brookhaven E821; Fermilab Muon g-2 final result 2025; BMW lattice collaboration
implication_if_solved: A surviving deviation would be direct evidence of particles beyond the Standard Model

observation_summary: Neutrinos have tiny but nonzero masses, at least a million times lighter than the electron, by an unknown mechanism
why_it_resists_explanation: The Standard Model as written gives them zero mass; whether they are their own antiparticles is still unmeasured
leading_hypotheses: Seesaw mechanism with heavy right-handed neutrinos; Dirac masses with new Yukawa suppression; radiative mass generation; extra dimensions
mainstream_view: Masses are established fact (2015 Nobel Prize); mechanism and absolute scale unknown
testable_prediction: Neutrinoless double beta decay would prove Majorana nature; KATRIN and cosmology bound the absolute scale
key_evidence_or_cases: Super-Kamiokande atmospheric oscillation; SNO solar flux; KamLAND; KATRIN limits
implication_if_solved: Would point to physics at a very high energy scale and possibly explain matter dominance

observation_summary: Quarks and leptons come in exactly three copies with masses spanning twelve orders of magnitude in no understood pattern
why_it_resists_explanation: No principle derives the number three or the mass ratios; the Yukawa couplings are free parameters
leading_hypotheses: Froggatt-Nielsen flavor symmetries; extra-dimensional localization; string landscape; modular flavor symmetry
mainstream_view: Called the flavor puzzle; acknowledged as entirely unexplained
testable_prediction: Flavor models predict specific correlations among mixing angles and rare decay rates
key_evidence_or_cases: Tau discovery 1975; Z-boson width constraining generations to three light families; CKM and PMNS matrices
implication_if_solved: Would explain the structure of all matter

observation_summary: Several constants appear to sit in narrow windows that permit stars, chemistry and complexity
why_it_resists_explanation: Any explanation must either derive the constants or explain the selection process, and neither is available
leading_hypotheses: String landscape plus eternal inflation and anthropic selection; a unique final theory fixing all constants; the apparent tuning is an artifact of limited imagination about alternative chemistries
mainstream_view: Contested: some view it as a deep clue, others as a selection artifact or a non-question
testable_prediction: Any theory deriving the constants from first principles would end the debate
key_evidence_or_cases: Carbon triple-alpha resonance sensitivity; cosmological constant smallness; proton-electron mass ratio stability
implication_if_solved: Would decide whether our universe is one of many or uniquely determined

observation_summary: Quark spins account for only about 30 percent of the proton spin rather than the expected 100 percent
why_it_resists_explanation: Decomposing spin among quarks, gluons and orbital angular momentum requires non-perturbative QCD that remains hard to compute
leading_hypotheses: Gluon spin contribution; quark orbital angular momentum; a combination requiring full three-dimensional proton tomography
mainstream_view: Accepted anomaly; being resolved incrementally by gluon polarization measurements
testable_prediction: The Electron-Ion Collider should close the spin budget
key_evidence_or_cases: EMC experiment 1987; RHIC polarized proton collisions; COMPASS
implication_if_solved: Would complete our account of how mass and spin arise from QCD

phenomenon: Confinement and the Yang-Mills mass gap
observation_summary: Quarks are never observed in isolation and gluons acquire an effective mass scale, but no rigorous derivation exists
why_it_resists_explanation: Confinement is a non-perturbative phenomenon with no known analytic proof; it is a Clay Millennium Prize problem
leading_hypotheses: Dual superconductor picture with monopole condensation; center vortices; AdS/CFT analogues; lattice evidence without proof
mainstream_view: Empirically beyond doubt; mathematically unproven
testable_prediction: A proof would specify the spectrum of glueball masses exactly
key_evidence_or_cases: Lattice QCD simulations; absence of free quarks; Regge trajectories
implication_if_solved: Would put quantum field theory on rigorous mathematical footing

observation_summary: Certain ceramics superconduct above 90 K and some hydrides near room temperature under pressure, by a pairing mechanism not explained by standard BCS theory
why_it_resists_explanation: The parent materials are strongly correlated Mott insulators where no controlled approximation works; the normal state itself is anomalous (strange metal)
leading_hypotheses: Spin-fluctuation pairing; resonating valence bond; quantum critical pairing; phonon-assisted mechanisms in hydrides
mainstream_view: Nearly forty years of intense work with no settled mechanism
testable_prediction: A correct theory would predict which compositions raise the critical temperature, enabling design rather than search
key_evidence_or_cases: Bednorz-Muller 1986; YBCO; LaH10 under pressure; strange-metal linear-in-T resistivity
implication_if_solved: Would enable room-temperature superconductors and transform energy transmission

observation_summary: Fluid flow above a critical Reynolds number becomes chaotic across a cascade of scales, and no closed statistical theory predicts it from the Navier-Stokes equations
why_it_resists_explanation: The equations are deterministic but nonlinear with strong scale coupling; closure requires uncontrolled approximations and existence of smooth solutions is itself unproven
leading_hypotheses: Kolmogorov scaling with intermittency corrections; multifractal models; renormalization approaches; exact coherent structures
mainstream_view: Called the last great unsolved problem of classical physics
testable_prediction: A real theory would predict drag and mixing rates from first principles without empirical constants
key_evidence_or_cases: Reynolds pipe experiments; Kolmogorov 1941 spectrum; measured intermittency deviations; direct numerical simulation
notable_names: Leonardo da Vinci; Reynolds; Kolmogorov; Feynman
implication_if_solved: Would transform aerodynamics, weather prediction, and plasma confinement

observation_summary: Nobody knows whether solutions to the fundamental fluid equations always remain smooth or can blow up in finite time
why_it_resists_explanation: Energy methods control too little in three dimensions; the nonlinear term can concentrate energy at small scales faster than viscosity dissipates it
leading_hypotheses: Global regularity holds; or singularities form and the equations break down as a physical model
mainstream_view: Clay Millennium Prize problem; recent computer-assisted work has found blowup in related and boundary-forced cases
testable_prediction: A blowup construction or a global regularity proof would settle it definitively
key_evidence_or_cases: Leray weak solutions 1934; Hou-Chen 2022 self-similar blowup with boundary; Tao averaged-equation blowup
implication_if_solved: Would clarify whether continuum fluid mechanics is self-consistent

locus: Cooled liquids such as silica and polymers
observation_summary: Liquids cooled below the melting point can become rigid without crystallizing, with viscosity rising by fourteen orders of magnitude over a modest temperature range and no structural change
why_it_resists_explanation: There is no identifiable order parameter or diverging structural length scale, so standard phase-transition theory does not apply
leading_hypotheses: Random first-order transition theory; mode-coupling theory; dynamical facilitation; frustration-limited domains; no true transition at all
mainstream_view: Widely cited as the deepest open problem in condensed matter alongside high-Tc
testable_prediction: Competing theories predict different behavior of the configurational entropy and the ideal glass temperature
key_evidence_or_cases: Vogel-Fulcher viscosity divergence; Kauzmann entropy paradox; ultrastable vapor-deposited glasses; colloidal glass imaging
implication_if_solved: Would explain the behavior of most engineered amorphous materials

observation_summary: Luminous spheres roughly 10 to 30 cm across persist for seconds, drift at low speed, sometimes pass through windows, and occasionally explode
why_it_resists_explanation: Reliable instrumented data is almost nonexistent; thousands of credible eyewitness reports but only one or two accidental spectra
leading_hypotheses: Oxidizing silicon nanoparticle aerosol from lightning-struck soil (Abrahamson-Dinniss); microwave cavity soliton; trapped plasma vortex; relativistic electron beam; some cases are retinal afterimage or transformer arcing
mainstream_view: Majority now accept it as a real physical phenomenon; mechanism undecided
testable_prediction: The silicon hypothesis predicts specific emission lines; lab replication should reproduce lifetime and buoyancy
key_evidence_or_cases: Great Thunderstorm of Widecombe 1638; 2012 Qinghai spectrum captured by chance; 1963 Jennison airliner observation; Hessdalen instrumented work
implication_if_solved: Would complete the physics of atmospheric electricity and possibly inform plasma confinement

observation_summary: Measured electric fields inside thunderclouds are roughly a factor of ten below the threshold needed to break down air, yet lightning starts anyway
why_it_resists_explanation: Instrumenting the initiation volume in situ is extremely difficult and the process is sub-millisecond
leading_hypotheses: Runaway relativistic electron breakdown seeded by cosmic rays; hydrometeor-enhanced local fields at ice needle tips; positive streamers from colliding precipitation
mainstream_view: Recognized open problem; recent radio interferometry has made major progress
testable_prediction: Interferometric mapping should always find initiating fast breakdown events at predicted field enhancements
key_evidence_or_cases: Balloon and aircraft field soundings; LOFAR and broadband interferometer initiation maps; terrestrial gamma-ray flash correlation
implication_if_solved: Would allow lightning prediction and protection design from first principles

observation_summary: Thunderstorms emit millisecond bursts of gamma rays up to tens of MeV, energies associated with nuclear processes not weather
why_it_resists_explanation: Requires electrons accelerated to relativistic energies in air, which standard thundercloud fields should not permit
leading_hypotheses: Relativistic runaway electron avalanche with feedback; leader-tip acceleration; cosmic-ray seeding
mainstream_view: Existence firmly established; the acceleration mechanism and link to lightning initiation remain open
testable_prediction: Correlated optical, radio and gamma detection should pin flashes to specific leader stages
key_evidence_or_cases: CGRO BATSE discovery 1994; RHESSI; Fermi GBM; ASIM on ISS; 2024 ALOFT aircraft campaign
implication_if_solved: Would reveal a natural particle accelerator in Earth atmosphere and possible aviation radiation risk

observation_summary: A bubble driven by sound collapses and emits a picosecond flash of light with an apparent temperature of tens of thousands of kelvin
why_it_resists_explanation: The energy concentration factor is about twelve orders of magnitude and the emission spectrum does not match any single simple model
leading_hypotheses: Imploding shock heating to plasma with bremsstrahlung emission; collision-induced emission; quantum vacuum radiation (fringe); proton-induced fusion claims (unreplicated)
mainstream_view: The phenomenon is a robust lab effect; the exact emission mechanism and peak conditions are still argued
testable_prediction: Spectral measurements at varying noble-gas doping should discriminate between plasma and molecular models
key_evidence_or_cases: Frenzel-Schultes 1934; single-bubble sonoluminescence Gaitan 1990; Taleyarkhan sonofusion claims (discredited)
implication_if_solved: Would clarify extreme energy focusing in fluids

phenomenon: Water anomalies and the second critical point
observation_summary: Water has dozens of anomalous properties including density maximum at 4 C, high heat capacity, and sixteen crystalline ice phases
why_it_resists_explanation: Hydrogen-bond network dynamics is a many-body quantum-and-classical problem; the proposed liquid-liquid transition lies in a hard-to-access supercooled regime
leading_hypotheses: Two-state model with high and low density liquid water separated by a hidden critical point; singularity-free scenario; critical-point-free interpretations
mainstream_view: Actively researched; the two-liquid picture has gained strong but not conclusive support
testable_prediction: Experiments in no-mans-land between 150 and 230 K should locate or exclude the critical point
key_evidence_or_cases: Density maximum; Angell power-law divergences; 2020 X-ray laser measurements of supercooled water; amorphous ice transitions
implication_if_solved: Would ground all of aqueous chemistry and biology in a correct theory of the solvent

observation_summary: Under some conditions hotter water appears to freeze before cooler water, contrary to naive expectation
why_it_resists_explanation: The effect is intermittent, highly sensitive to container, dissolved gas, convection and nucleation, and some careful studies fail to find it at all
leading_hypotheses: Supercooling differences; convection and evaporative cooling; dissolved gas effects; nonequilibrium relaxation shortcuts in state space; artifact of inconsistent measurement protocol
mainstream_view: Existence in water contested after a careful 2016 null study, but an analogous anomalous relaxation is now rigorously demonstrated in other systems
testable_prediction: A controlled protocol specifying nucleation sites should produce reproducible crossing of cooling curves
key_evidence_or_cases: Aristotle; Mpemba and Osborne 1969; Burridge and Linden 2016 null result; granular gas and colloid demonstrations
notable_names: Aristotle; Mpemba; Burridge; Lu and Raz
implication_if_solved: Would clarify nonequilibrium relaxation pathways far from equilibrium

observation_summary: Millisecond radio bursts releasing as much energy as the Sun emits in days, some repeating, some one-off, arriving from cosmological distances
why_it_resists_explanation: The emission requires coherent processes in extreme magnetic fields; the repeating and non-repeating populations may have different origins entirely
leading_hypotheses: Magnetar flares (confirmed for at least one Galactic source); neutron star mergers; cosmic comb interactions; asteroid-magnetar collisions
mainstream_view: A real astrophysical class; magnetars confirmed as one source but the full population and mechanism remain open
testable_prediction: Localization of hundreds more bursts should map host-galaxy types and reveal whether multiple channels exist
key_evidence_or_cases: Lorimer burst 2007; FRB 121102 repeater; SGR 1935+2154 Galactic FRB 2020; CHIME catalog of thousands
implication_if_solved: Would provide a precise cosmological probe of intergalactic baryons

observation_summary: Single particles arrive with macroscopic kinetic energies up to 3x10^20 eV, above the theoretical GZK cutoff, with no identifiable source in their arrival direction
why_it_resists_explanation: Particles of that energy should lose energy within about 160 million light years, so sources must be nearby, yet the sky in those directions appears empty
leading_hypotheses: Active galactic nuclei; gamma-ray burst remnants; magnetar birth; unknown local accelerators; magnetic deflection scrambling arrival directions; exotic top-down decay
mainstream_view: Existence certain; sources genuinely unidentified
testable_prediction: Larger exposure should reveal anisotropy correlating with a specific source catalog
key_evidence_or_cases: Oh-My-God particle 1991 (Fly Eye); Amaterasu particle 2021 (Telescope Array); Pierre Auger hotspot
implication_if_solved: Would identify the most powerful particle accelerators in nature

observation_summary: Two radio pulses appeared to come up through the Earth at angles where any neutrino should have been absorbed
why_it_resists_explanation: Conventional neutrinos cannot traverse thousands of kilometers of rock at those energies; IceCube sees no corresponding flux
leading_hypotheses: Reflected cosmic-ray air showers off subsurface ice features; transition radiation in firn; Askaryan artifacts; supersymmetric stau or sterile neutrino (strongly disfavored by IceCube limits)
mainstream_view: Increasingly viewed as instrumental or ice-reflection artifacts rather than new physics
testable_prediction: PUEO, the ANITA successor, should see either a consistent population or nothing
key_evidence_or_cases: ANITA-I and ANITA-III upward events; IceCube non-detection follow-up
implication_if_solved: If real would require particle physics beyond the Standard Model

observation_summary: A 72-second narrowband 1420 MHz signal 30 sigma above background appeared once in the direction of Sagittarius and was never detected again
why_it_resists_explanation: It appeared in only one of two feed horns consistent with a sky source, lasted exactly one beam transit, and has never repeated despite dozens of searches
leading_hypotheses: Interstellar scintillation of a faint steady source; hydrogen cloud maser brightened by a transient (2024 Arecibo archival proposal); Earth-origin signal reflected off space debris; deliberate transmission
mainstream_view: Treated as a real unexplained detection, not a hoax; no consensus on cause and no scientific claim of extraterrestrial origin
testable_prediction: The scintillation and maser hypotheses predict a dim persistent source detectable with modern sensitivity
key_evidence_or_cases: Original Big Ear printout marked 6EQUJ5; META and Very Large Array follow-ups all null
implication_if_solved: Would either close a famous SETI case or constitute the first detected technosignature

observation_summary: An F-type star showed irregular dips in brightness up to 22 percent lasting days, plus a long-term fading, unlike any known stellar variability
why_it_resists_explanation: No circumstellar disk infrared excess was found, which excludes most dust-cloud models, yet the dips are chromatic so something absorbs light unevenly
leading_hypotheses: Uneven circumstellar dust clouds from a shattered exomoon or comet family; internal stellar variability; intervening interstellar medium structure; alien megastructure (effectively ruled out by chromaticity)
mainstream_view: Dust is now the favored explanation but the dust source and long-term fading remain unexplained
testable_prediction: Continued multiband monitoring should confirm wavelength-dependent dimming consistent with specific grain sizes
key_evidence_or_cases: Kepler light curve; 2017 multiband campaign showing chromatic dips; Boyajian crowdfunded monitoring
implication_if_solved: Would reveal a new mode of circumstellar evolution

observation_summary: The object accelerated away from the Sun more than gravity alone allows, showed no cometary coma, and had an extreme elongated shape and no detected rotation-induced fragmentation
why_it_resists_explanation: Outgassing would normally produce a visible coma and spin-up; none was observed, and the object left the solar system before close study
leading_hypotheses: Hydrogen or nitrogen ice outgassing with invisible emission; extremely porous fractal dust aggregate; radiation-pressure-driven thin body; hydrogen iceberg; artificial light sail (minority view)
mainstream_view: Natural explanations are strongly favored; no single one fits all observations cleanly
testable_prediction: Future interstellar objects (2I/Borisov, 3I/ATLAS) sampled in detail should show whether such bodies are common
key_evidence_or_cases: Pan-STARRS discovery; non-gravitational acceleration measurement; Spitzer non-detection of dust
notable_names: Meech; Micheli; Bialy and Loeb; Jewitt
implication_if_solved: Would characterize material ejected from other planetary systems

phenomenon: Fermi paradox and the Great Silence
observation_summary: The galaxy is old enough for a single expansionist civilization to have colonized it many times over, yet no technosignature or artifact has been detected
why_it_resists_explanation: The explanation space includes both astrophysical and sociological factors, almost none of which is currently measurable
leading_hypotheses: Rare Earth / rare abiogenesis; great filter at some evolutionary step; intelligence self-destructs; dark forest deliberate silence; we are early; detection methods are far too insensitive; zoo hypothesis
mainstream_view: A legitimate scientific puzzle given the scale of the galaxy; wide disagreement on whether it needs explanation at all
testable_prediction: Exoplanet biosignature surveys and deep technosignature searches will constrain the early filter steps
key_evidence_or_cases: Absence of Dyson sphere infrared excess in surveys; null SETI results since 1960; no solar-system artifacts found
implication_if_solved: Would tell us whether complex life and intelligence are common or essentially unique

phenomenon: CMB Cold Spot and large-scale anomalies
observation_summary: An unusually large cold region in the CMB plus hemispherical power asymmetry and quadrupole-octupole alignment (axis of evil) deviate from statistical isotropy
why_it_resists_explanation: The anomalies are individually marginal, and the significance depends on how the search was defined, so selection effects are hard to exclude
leading_hypotheses: A large supervoid along the line of sight (insufficient to explain magnitude); statistical fluke amplified by look-elsewhere effect; primordial non-Gaussianity; collision with another bubble universe; residual foreground
mainstream_view: Measured features are real; whether they are anomalous beyond chance is actively debated
testable_prediction: Independent large-scale structure surveys and CMB polarization should show the same anomaly if primordial
key_evidence_or_cases: WMAP detection; Planck confirmation of the same features; Eridanus supervoid surveys
implication_if_solved: Could indicate departures from cosmological isotropy or pre-inflationary physics

observation_summary: Big Bang nucleosynthesis predicts about three times more lithium-7 than is observed in the oldest stars, a stable 4 to 5 sigma discrepancy
why_it_resists_explanation: Nuclear reaction rates are well measured and the predicted baryon density is independently confirmed by the CMB, leaving no easy adjustment
leading_hypotheses: Stellar depletion by mixing and diffusion in the atmospheres of old stars; unknown resonance in a key nuclear reaction; decaying particle during nucleosynthesis; varying constants
mainstream_view: Recognized as the outstanding failure of an otherwise spectacularly successful theory
testable_prediction: Precision measurements of lithium in globular clusters and better nuclear cross sections should discriminate
key_evidence_or_cases: Spite plateau 1982; Planck baryon density; measured deuterium agreement contrasted with lithium disagreement
implication_if_solved: Would either validate stellar mixing models or reveal new physics in the first minutes

observation_summary: A nanohertz gravitational-wave background has been detected with an amplitude somewhat higher than most supermassive black hole binary models predicted
why_it_resists_explanation: The signal integrates all sources and cannot yet be decomposed; cosmological and astrophysical origins have overlapping spectra
leading_hypotheses: Population of supermassive black hole binaries with enhanced merger rates; cosmic strings; first-order phase transition in the early universe; inflationary relics
mainstream_view: Detection accepted; interpretation open
testable_prediction: Anisotropy and individual resolvable binaries would confirm the astrophysical origin
key_evidence_or_cases: NANOGrav 15-year data; EPTA; PPTA; CPTA simultaneous announcements 2023
implication_if_solved: Could be the first observation of a cosmological phase transition

locus: Early Earth around 4 billion years ago
observation_summary: Self-replicating, metabolizing, information-carrying chemistry arose from geochemistry in a few hundred million years, exactly once as far as we can tell
why_it_resists_explanation: No laboratory has produced a self-sustaining, open-ended replicating chemical system from plausible prebiotic feedstocks; the transition from chemistry to heredity is unbridged
leading_hypotheses: RNA world with ribozyme self-replication; metabolism-first in alkaline hydrothermal vents; lipid-world protocells; cyanosulfidic surface chemistry (Sutherland); iron-sulfur world; panspermia relocating but not solving the problem
mainstream_view: The central unsolved problem in biology; steady progress on individual steps, no end-to-end path
testable_prediction: A successful demonstration would create a Darwinian chemical system in the lab under prebiotic conditions
key_evidence_or_cases: Miller-Urey 1953; ribozyme polymerases; Sutherland pyrimidine synthesis; Powner-Szostak protocell work
notable_names: Darwin; Oparin; Miller; Orgel; Szostak; Sutherland; Lane
implication_if_solved: Would tell us whether life is a cosmic commonplace or a near-miracle

observation_summary: Life uses exclusively left-handed amino acids and right-handed sugars, while abiotic chemistry produces both equally
why_it_resists_explanation: Spontaneous symmetry breaking gives a tiny bias that must then be amplified to near-total purity, and no complete route from physics to biology is demonstrated
leading_hypotheses: Circularly polarized starlight in star-forming regions; parity violation in weak decays; crystallization amplification (Soai reaction, Viedma ripening); magnetochiral effects on magnetite surfaces; frozen accident
mainstream_view: Amplification mechanisms are demonstrated in vitro; the original bias and its link to biology are unresolved
testable_prediction: Meteoritic and cometary samples should show consistent enantiomeric excesses if astrophysical in origin
key_evidence_or_cases: Pasteur 1848 tartrate separation; Murchison meteorite L-excess; Soai autocatalysis; polarized light in Orion
implication_if_solved: Would constrain where and how life began

observation_summary: A near-universal mapping of 64 codons to 20 amino acids exists with clear non-random structure but no agreed causal history
why_it_resists_explanation: The code is self-referential: translation requires proteins that require translation, so the bootstrapping order is hard to reconstruct from surviving evidence
leading_hypotheses: Stereochemical affinity between codons and amino acids; coevolution with biosynthetic pathways; error-minimization selection; frozen accident (Crick); expansion from a smaller primordial code
mainstream_view: Acknowledged as unsolved; multiple partial explanations each capture some structure
testable_prediction: Codon-amino-acid affinity should be measurable in aptamer binding experiments
key_evidence_or_cases: Nirenberg-Matthaei codon assignment; code error-minimization statistics; aptamer binding studies
implication_if_solved: Would reveal the architecture of the earliest cells

locus: Single event roughly 2 billion years ago
observation_summary: Complex cells with nuclei, mitochondria and internal membranes arose apparently once, from an archaeal host engulfing a bacterium, with no surviving intermediates
why_it_resists_explanation: Endosymbiosis is established but the sequence of events, the mechanism of engulfment by a cell without phagocytosis, and the origin of the nucleus and sex are all unresolved
leading_hypotheses: Hydrogen hypothesis; inside-out model for nuclear origin; Asgard archaeal host with actin-based protrusions; syntrophy models; viral eukaryogenesis
mainstream_view: Endosymbiotic origin is consensus; the detailed path is genuinely open
testable_prediction: Cultured Asgard archaea should reveal whether they can engulf partners and how their cytoskeleton behaves
key_evidence_or_cases: Margulis 1967; mitochondrial genome phylogeny; Lokiarchaeota discovery 2015; cultured Prometheoarchaeum 2020
implication_if_solved: Would explain the single bottleneck that made all complex life possible

locus: Fossil record about 538 million years ago
observation_summary: Nearly all modern animal body plans appear in the fossil record within roughly 20 to 25 million years after billions of years of mostly simple life
why_it_resists_explanation: Multiple candidate causes operate on the same timescale and the fossil record before the event is sparse, making causal attribution very hard
leading_hypotheses: Rising atmospheric oxygen crossing a threshold; evolution of developmental gene regulatory networks (Hox toolkit); predation-driven arms race; calcium and phosphate ocean chemistry shifts; ecological feedback after Snowball Earth; partly an artifact of preservation bias toward hard parts
mainstream_view: The pattern is real but partially a preservation artifact; the trigger remains multi-causal and unsettled
testable_prediction: Molecular clock dates, Ediacaran biomarker records and oxygen proxies should converge on one ordering of causes
key_evidence_or_cases: Burgess Shale; Chengjiang biota; small shelly fossil interval; Ediacaran trace fossils
implication_if_solved: Would explain the origin of animal diversity and complex ecosystems

observation_summary: Physical brain processes are accompanied by subjective experience, and no account explains why there is something it is like to be in a brain state
why_it_resists_explanation: All functional and physical descriptions appear to leave the experiential aspect untouched; the explanatory gap is arguably not even the right kind of question for empirical methods
leading_hypotheses: Integrated Information Theory; global workspace theory; higher-order theories; predictive processing; illusionism (experience as introspective model); panpsychism; mysterianism (cognitively closed to us)
mainstream_view: Deeply contested; some consider it the hardest open question in science, others consider it confused
testable_prediction: Theories differ measurably on whether cerebellar or posterior-cortical damage abolishes experience, and on perturbational complexity indices
key_evidence_or_cases: Perturbational complexity index in vegetative states; binocular rivalry; blindsight; split-brain cases; no-report paradigms
notable_names: Chalmers; Dennett; Tononi; Koch; Nagel; Seth
implication_if_solved: Would determine which systems are sentient, with enormous ethical consequences

observation_summary: The specific felt character of red, pain or a musical interval has no known mapping to neural quantities, and there is no way to compare across individuals
why_it_resists_explanation: Qualia are private by definition; no third-person measurement is known to access them, so inverted-spectrum scenarios cannot be ruled out empirically
leading_hypotheses: Representationalism; neural identity theories; IIT geometric qualia space; eliminativism; quality spaces grounded in discrimination structure
mainstream_view: Core of the hard problem; conceptual not just empirical
testable_prediction: Similarity structure of qualia should be recoverable from neural similarity structure if representational theories hold
key_evidence_or_cases: Color-space psychophysics; synesthesia; cortical color center lesions; tetrachromat reports
implication_if_solved: Would complete the link between physics and experience

observation_summary: Features processed in anatomically separate regions are experienced as a single unified object at a single moment with no central convergence zone
why_it_resists_explanation: No anatomical structure receives all the relevant signals, and proposed temporal codes have not been shown to be necessary or sufficient
leading_hypotheses: Gamma-band synchrony; attention-based feature integration; hierarchical predictive binding; recurrent cortical loops; the problem is dissolved by the right representational framework
mainstream_view: Active research area; no accepted solution
testable_prediction: Disrupting gamma synchrony should selectively break feature conjunctions if that is the binding code
key_evidence_or_cases: Illusory conjunctions in Treisman experiments; Balint syndrome; gamma coherence recordings
implication_if_solved: Would explain how a unified percept arises from distributed processing

observation_summary: Chemically unrelated molecules including xenon, a noble gas, reliably and reversibly abolish consciousness, and we do not know the common final pathway
why_it_resists_explanation: The agents have different molecular targets, yet produce similar loss of consciousness, implying the explanation lies at a network level we cannot yet specify
leading_hypotheses: GABA-A and NMDA receptor modulation; thalamocortical disconnection; disruption of cortical integration and long-range connectivity; lipid raft and membrane-order effects; microtubule quantum effects (fringe)
mainstream_view: Clinically mastered, mechanistically unexplained; routinely cited as a standing puzzle in medicine
testable_prediction: Measures of cortical integration should predict depth of anesthesia across all agents including xenon
key_evidence_or_cases: Xenon anesthesia; Meyer-Overton lipid solubility correlation and its exceptions; perturbational complexity index drops; anesthetic awareness cases
notable_names: Morton; Meyer; Overton; Franks and Lieb; Mashour
implication_if_solved: Would let us monitor consciousness directly and build safer anesthetics

observation_summary: Every well-studied animal sleeps, sacrificing time and safety, and prolonged deprivation is fatal, yet no single function accounts for it
why_it_resists_explanation: Many functions correlate with sleep (memory consolidation, metabolic clearance, synaptic downscaling) without any one being demonstrably the reason it evolved
leading_hypotheses: Synaptic homeostasis and downscaling; glymphatic metabolic clearance; memory consolidation and replay; energy conservation; immune function; developmental brain wiring; multiple independent functions co-opted
mainstream_view: Multiple partial functions established; the core evolutionary function is still debated
testable_prediction: Selectively blocking one proposed function should reproduce specific deprivation symptoms but not others
key_evidence_or_cases: Rechtschaffen rat deprivation lethality; fatal familial insomnia; glymphatic clearance imaging 2013; jellyfish and fruit-fly sleep states
implication_if_solved: Would reframe sleep medicine and explain a third of every animal life

observation_summary: The brain generates immersive hallucinatory narratives during sleep with high metabolic cost and no obvious behavioral payoff
why_it_resists_explanation: Dream content is only accessible through unreliable recall; no manipulation cleanly separates dreaming from REM physiology
leading_hypotheses: Threat simulation rehearsal; emotional memory regulation; overfitted brain hypothesis (noise injection to prevent overgeneralization); random activation with narrative confabulation; continuity of waking concerns
mainstream_view: Recognized as unresolved; several competing functional accounts with partial support
testable_prediction: Lucid-dream two-way communication experiments can now test content hypotheses in real time
key_evidence_or_cases: REM-sleep behavior disorder; lucid dreaming communication 2021; dream-content lab studies; targeted memory reactivation
implication_if_solved: Would clarify the computational role of offline brain activity

observation_summary: Memories persist for decades while the proteins at synapses turn over in days to weeks
why_it_resists_explanation: Synaptic weight storage alone seems too unstable; proposed stable substrates such as perineuronal nets, epigenetic marks and prion-like proteins are not fully demonstrated as the carrier
leading_hypotheses: Synaptic engram with distributed redundancy; CaMKII and CPEB prion-like self-sustaining states; epigenetic DNA methylation; perineuronal net structural encoding; intrinsic neuronal excitability; intracellular RNA-based storage
mainstream_view: Engram cells are identified and manipulable; the stable physical carrier within them is not settled
testable_prediction: Erasing a candidate substrate while sparing others should selectively abolish specific memories
key_evidence_or_cases: Engram cell optogenetic tagging and reactivation; PKMzeta maintenance experiments; planarian and Aplysia RNA transfer experiments
implication_if_solved: Would enable targeted treatment of memory disorders and PTSD

observation_summary: Trained planarians that regenerate a new head reportedly retain learned behaviors, implying memory stored outside the brain
why_it_resists_explanation: Replication history is uneven; the original McConnell cannibalism experiments were discredited, though a modern careful replication reported retention
leading_hypotheses: Memory encoded in non-neural tissue such as epigenetic or RNA states; retained peripheral nervous system; automated-assay artifacts and habituation confounds
mainstream_view: Treated cautiously; the 2013 automated replication is respected but not broadly confirmed
testable_prediction: Independent labs with blinded automated tracking should reproduce retention and localize the substrate
key_evidence_or_cases: McConnell 1962 claims; Shomrat and Levin 2013 automated replication
implication_if_solved: Would prove memory can be stored non-synaptically

observation_summary: Patients with severe dementia or brain damage sometimes recover coherent speech, recognition and personality hours to days before death
why_it_resists_explanation: The brains involved have severe documented atrophy, so recovery of function conflicts with the standard structural account of memory and personality loss
leading_hypotheses: Transient neurochemical surge near death; disinhibition from failing inhibitory networks; preserved networks that were functionally silenced rather than destroyed; reporting and recall bias in family accounts
mainstream_view: Increasingly accepted as a real clinical phenomenon worth study; mechanism unknown and research is mostly retrospective
testable_prediction: Prospective EEG monitoring in hospice should capture an identifiable physiological signature
key_evidence_or_cases: Collected case series by Nahm and Greyson; hospice staff survey data; documented cases with autopsy-confirmed severe atrophy
implication_if_solved: Would show dementia symptoms are partly functional and potentially reversible

observation_summary: Inert treatments produce measurable physiological change including analgesia, motor improvement in Parkinson disease, and immune responses, sometimes even when the patient knows the pill is inert
why_it_resists_explanation: The effect depends on expectation, conditioning and context in ways that cross from psychology to measurable neurochemistry with no complete causal model
leading_hypotheses: Endogenous opioid and dopamine release; descending pain modulation; classical conditioning of immune and endocrine responses; predictive processing and prior updating; reporting bias and regression to the mean for part of the effect
mainstream_view: Core mechanisms partly mapped; open-label placebo effectiveness is not well explained
testable_prediction: Naloxone blockade should abolish specific components; open-label placebo should scale with ritual rather than belief
key_evidence_or_cases: Naloxone-reversible placebo analgesia; Parkinson dopamine release imaging; open-label placebo trials in IBS
implication_if_solved: Would let clinicians harness expectation deliberately and ethically

observation_summary: Histologically confirmed malignancies occasionally regress completely without effective treatment, roughly one in sixty to one hundred thousand cases
why_it_resists_explanation: The cases are rare, retrospective and heterogeneous, so prospective mechanistic study is nearly impossible
leading_hypotheses: Spontaneous immune recognition after infection or fever; loss of tumor angiogenic support; differentiation of the tumor; withdrawal of hormonal drive; misdiagnosis or unrecorded treatment in some reported cases
mainstream_view: Accepted as real but rare; mechanism unknown case by case
testable_prediction: Immune profiling of regressing tumors should identify a consistent recognition event
key_evidence_or_cases: Documented neuroblastoma and renal cell carcinoma regressions; Coley toxin historical responses; melanoma regression case series
implication_if_solved: Would reveal the immune mechanisms needed for durable cancer control

phenomenon: Myalgic encephalomyelitis and chronic fatigue syndrome
observation_summary: Severe post-exertional collapse, cognitive impairment and autonomic dysfunction with no consistent biomarker or accepted pathophysiology
why_it_resists_explanation: Heterogeneous diagnostic criteria, no animal model, and historical dismissal left the field with weak data; the defining symptom is a delayed response that is hard to measure
leading_hypotheses: Persistent viral infection or antigen; mitochondrial and metabolic dysfunction; autoimmunity against autonomic receptors; microclot and endothelial dysfunction; neuroinflammation; central sensitization
mainstream_view: Recognized as a real biological illness; pathophysiology genuinely unknown
testable_prediction: Two-day cardiopulmonary exercise testing reproducibly shows reduced second-day capacity, a candidate objective marker
key_evidence_or_cases: Two-day CPET studies; NIH intramural deep phenotyping study 2024; overlap with long COVID
implication_if_solved: Would give millions of patients a diagnosis and a treatment target

observation_summary: Persistent multi-system symptoms months to years after SARS-CoV-2 infection with no single causal mechanism identified
why_it_resists_explanation: Multiple plausible mechanisms appear in different patient subsets, and the phenotype overlaps several poorly understood syndromes
leading_hypotheses: Viral persistence in tissue reservoirs; immune dysregulation and autoantibodies; microvascular clotting and endothelial damage; reactivation of Epstein-Barr virus; serotonin depletion via gut dysfunction; vagal and brainstem injury
mainstream_view: Real and extensively documented; mechanistically unresolved and probably multiple diseases
testable_prediction: Antiviral trials should resolve symptoms specifically in the viral-persistence subgroup
key_evidence_or_cases: RECOVER cohort data; persistent spike protein detection studies; autoantibody panels; brainstem imaging
implication_if_solved: Would guide treatment for a mass disabling condition and clarify post-viral syndromes generally

observation_summary: Apparently healthy infants die suddenly in sleep with no cause found at autopsy, even after prevention campaigns cut rates sharply
why_it_resists_explanation: It is a diagnosis of exclusion covering probably several distinct mechanisms; the fatal event is unobserved and leaves no reliable marker
leading_hypotheses: Brainstem serotonergic dysfunction impairing arousal from hypoxia; cardiac channelopathies; triple-risk model combining vulnerability, critical period and stressor; butyrylcholinesterase deficiency (2022, needs replication)
mainstream_view: Risk factors well established and actionable; underlying mechanism still unexplained in most cases
testable_prediction: A predictive biomarker measured at birth should identify the vulnerable subgroup prospectively
key_evidence_or_cases: Back to Sleep campaign reducing incidence by half; brainstem 5-HT receptor abnormalities in SIDS autopsies; BChE study 2022
implication_if_solved: Would allow screening and prevention of remaining cases

observation_summary: Amyloid plaques and tau tangles accompany progressive dementia, but amyloid removal yields only modest clinical benefit and many plaque-laden brains are cognitively normal
why_it_resists_explanation: Causal direction is unclear: amyloid may be a response rather than the driver; decades of amyloid-targeted trials mostly failed
leading_hypotheses: Amyloid cascade (weakened but not dead); tau propagation as the proximate driver; neuroinflammation and microglial dysfunction; vascular contribution; infectious trigger such as herpesvirus; metabolic and insulin-resistance models; lysosomal failure
mainstream_view: Amyloid remains central but no longer dominant; the field now treats causation as open
testable_prediction: Anti-tau and anti-inflammatory trials should outperform amyloid clearance if those mechanisms are primary
key_evidence_or_cases: Nun Study plaque-without-dementia cases; lecanemab and donanemab modest efficacy; failed solanezumab trials; APOE4 genetics
implication_if_solved: Would unlock treatment for the leading cause of dementia

locus: All complex organisms except a few
observation_summary: Organisms decline functionally with time in a species-specific way, while some animals show negligible senescence and some are biologically immortal
why_it_resists_explanation: Aging involves many simultaneously degrading systems, so distinguishing causes from consequences is extremely difficult; no single intervention reverses all hallmarks
leading_hypotheses: Accumulated somatic damage; epigenetic information loss (Sinclair); antagonistic pleiotropy and disposable soma evolutionary theories; mitochondrial decline; stem cell exhaustion; programmed hyperfunction (Blagosklonny)
mainstream_view: Twelve hallmarks catalogued; no agreed root cause and vigorous debate between damage and programmatic camps
testable_prediction: Partial epigenetic reprogramming should restore youthful function if information loss is the root cause
key_evidence_or_cases: Hydra and naked mole rat negligible senescence; Turritopsis immortality; calorie restriction across taxa; Yamanaka factor partial reprogramming in mice
implication_if_solved: Would make most chronic disease addressable at the root

observation_summary: Mortality rates appear to plateau in extreme old age yet nobody has verified exceeding about 122 years, despite billions of lives
why_it_resists_explanation: The number of supercentenarians is tiny, documentation is error-prone, and statistical models disagree on whether a hard limit exists
leading_hypotheses: Hard biological limit near 115 to 125; no limit but vanishing probability; late-life mortality plateau allowing eventual records; age-record errors inflating the apparent ceiling
mainstream_view: Actively contested between limit and no-limit camps
testable_prediction: Verified new records above 122 or a measured mortality plateau would settle it
key_evidence_or_cases: Jeanne Calment 122 years; Italian supercentenarian mortality plateau data; Dong et al 2016 limit claim and rebuttals
implication_if_solved: Would set expectations for longevity medicine

observation_summary: Identical cells reliably build complex anatomy with correct size, shape and left-right asymmetry, far more reproducibly than gradient models predict
why_it_resists_explanation: Gene regulatory networks are mapped but the translation from molecular gradients to precise geometry and scale invariance is not derivable
leading_hypotheses: Turing reaction-diffusion patterning; positional information from morphogen gradients; mechanical feedback and tissue tension; bioelectric prepatterns (Levin); self-organizing criticality
mainstream_view: Many mechanisms demonstrated in parts; a predictive theory of form is absent
testable_prediction: A correct theory should allow designing a target anatomy by specifying signals, which bioelectric experiments partly achieve
key_evidence_or_cases: Turing 1952; Drosophila Bicoid gradient precision; planarian two-headed stable regeneration via bioelectric manipulation; organoid self-organization
implication_if_solved: Would enable regenerative medicine and organ engineering

phenomenon: Levinthal paradox and protein folding kinetics
observation_summary: Proteins find their native fold in microseconds to seconds despite an astronomically large conformational space
why_it_resists_explanation: Prediction of structure is now largely solved by machine learning, but the physical folding pathway and misfolding diseases remain mechanistically open
leading_hypotheses: Funneled energy landscape; hierarchical and nucleation-condensation folding; chaperone-assisted pathways; machine learning captures structure without revealing kinetics
mainstream_view: Structure prediction solved in practice by AlphaFold; folding dynamics and misfolding are still open
testable_prediction: Molecular dynamics at longer timescales should reproduce measured folding rates for arbitrary sequences
key_evidence_or_cases: Levinthal 1969; Anfinsen refolding experiments; AlphaFold2 CASP14 2020; Anton MD simulations
implication_if_solved: Would allow rational design of proteins and treatment of misfolding disease

observation_summary: Enzymes accelerate reactions by factors up to 10^17, beyond what static transition-state stabilization models fully account for
why_it_resists_explanation: Measuring the contribution of dynamics versus electrostatic preorganization requires separating effects that are experimentally entangled
leading_hypotheses: Electrostatic preorganization (Warshel); promoting vibrational modes and protein dynamics; quantum tunneling of hydrogen; near-attack conformations; entropy reduction
mainstream_view: Electrostatic preorganization is the mainstream view; the role of dynamics is heatedly debated
testable_prediction: De novo designed enzymes should reach natural rates if the theory is complete
key_evidence_or_cases: Designed enzymes falling orders of magnitude short of natural rates; kinetic isotope effects showing tunneling; catalytic antibody studies
implication_if_solved: Would allow designing industrial enzymes to order

locus: Migratory birds turtles and other animals
observation_summary: Many animals sense Earth magnetic field direction and intensity accurately enough to navigate thousands of kilometers, with no confirmed sensory organ
why_it_resists_explanation: No receptor cell has been unambiguously identified; proposed mechanisms are physically delicate and difficult to probe in vivo
leading_hypotheses: Radical-pair quantum magnetoreception in cryptochrome in the retina; magnetite-based mechanoreceptors; electromagnetic induction in elasmobranchs; symbiotic magnetotactic bacteria
mainstream_view: Behavior firmly established; mechanism unresolved, though cryptochrome 4 magnetic sensitivity was shown in vitro in 2021
testable_prediction: Knocking out cryptochrome 4 should abolish magnetic orientation if the radical-pair model is correct
key_evidence_or_cases: European robin orientation under radiofrequency disruption; Cry4 in vitro magnetosensitivity 2021; loggerhead turtle magnetic maps
implication_if_solved: Would demonstrate a quantum effect used functionally by biology

observation_summary: Butterflies several generations removed from the last migrants navigate to specific small overwintering groves they have never visited
why_it_resists_explanation: The information cannot be learned individually, so it must be encoded genetically and decoded by a brain of under a million neurons
leading_hypotheses: Time-compensated sun compass with circadian clock in antennae; magnetic inclination compass as backup; genetically encoded heading preference; landscape funneling
mainstream_view: Sun compass mechanism substantially worked out; precise endpoint targeting still unexplained
testable_prediction: Clock-shifted and magnetically shielded butterflies should mispredict in specific directions
key_evidence_or_cases: Urquhart tagging program; antennal clock experiments; flight simulator orientation studies
implication_if_solved: Would reveal how complex navigation can be genetically encoded

phenomenon: Eel reproduction and the Sargasso Sea
observation_summary: European eels were never observed spawning in the wild until very recently, and the full migration and reproductive behavior remain largely unobserved
why_it_resists_explanation: The spawning grounds are deep, remote and vast, and adult eels die after spawning, making direct observation extraordinarily difficult
leading_hypotheses: Spawning in the Sargasso Sea at depth; multiple spawning areas; migration guided by magnetic and olfactory cues
mainstream_view: The Sargasso spawning area is confirmed by larvae distribution and 2022 satellite tracking; eggs and spawning adults still essentially unobserved in situ
testable_prediction: Deep-sea observation in the predicted area during the spawning window should capture spawning adults
key_evidence_or_cases: Schmidt larval surveys 1920s; 2022 satellite tagging of adults reaching the Sargasso; no wild eggs ever found
implication_if_solved: Would permit conservation of a critically endangered species

observation_summary: Energy transfer in photosynthetic antenna complexes showed long-lived oscillatory signals initially interpreted as functional quantum coherence at room temperature
why_it_resists_explanation: Later work attributed much of the oscillation to vibrational rather than electronic coherence, and whether coherence improves efficiency is unresolved
leading_hypotheses: Vibronic coherence assisting transfer; purely classical hopping with vibrational beating; environment-assisted quantum transport
mainstream_view: Initial strong claims have been substantially walked back; a weaker vibronic role is plausible
testable_prediction: Two-dimensional electronic spectroscopy with better controls should separate electronic from vibrational contributions
key_evidence_or_cases: Engel et al 2007 FMO complex; Duan et al 2017 reinterpretation; cryptophyte algae studies
implication_if_solved: Would show whether evolution exploits quantum coherence

observation_summary: Humans discriminate on the order of a trillion odor mixtures, and similar-shaped molecules can smell completely different while different shapes smell alike
why_it_resists_explanation: Shape-based docking fails to predict percept reliably; the combinatorial receptor code is only partly decoded
leading_hypotheses: Combinatorial receptor activation with shape and physicochemical features; molecular vibration sensing by inelastic electron tunneling (Turin, minority view); dynamic receptor-ligand kinetics
mainstream_view: Combinatorial coding is mainstream; percept prediction from structure is still unsolved and the vibration theory is largely rejected
testable_prediction: Isotopically substituted odorants should smell different only if vibration sensing operates
key_evidence_or_cases: Buck and Axel receptor family 1991 (Nobel 2004); deuterated acetophenone experiments in humans (null) and flies (positive); machine-learning odor maps
implication_if_solved: Would allow digital prediction and synthesis of smells

phenomenon: Why organisms sleep-like states appear in brainless animals
observation_summary: Animals with no central brain show reversible quiescent states with increased arousal thresholds and rebound after deprivation
why_it_resists_explanation: Sleep was assumed to be a brain function, so its presence without a brain undercuts neural-centric theories and no cellular theory is established
leading_hypotheses: Sleep as a cellular or metabolic necessity predating nervous systems; local network homeostasis independent of centralization
mainstream_view: Accepted finding that reframes sleep research; implications unresolved
testable_prediction: Single-cell metabolic markers should cycle with the quiescent state
key_evidence_or_cases: Nath et al Cassiopea 2017; hydra sleep 2020; C elegans lethargus
implication_if_solved: Would locate sleep function at the cellular rather than network level

observation_summary: A single-celled organism without a nervous system solves mazes, approximates optimal transport networks, and shows habituation and anticipation of periodic events
why_it_resists_explanation: It has no neurons, so the computational substrate must be cytoplasmic and chemical, and no formal model fully reproduces the behavior
leading_hypotheses: Distributed chemical and mechanical oscillator computation; cytoplasmic flow as analog computation; reinforcement via tube thickening following flow
mainstream_view: Behavior is robust and reproducible; the computational mechanism is modeled only approximately
testable_prediction: Flow-reinforcement models should predict network topology in novel geometries
key_evidence_or_cases: Nakagaki maze solving 2000; Tero Tokyo rail network replication 2010; anticipation of periodic cold shocks
implication_if_solved: Would give a template for non-neural distributed computation

observation_summary: Plants transmit electrical and chemical signals, respond to touch and sound, share resources through fungal networks, and show habituation
why_it_resists_explanation: The vocabulary of cognition is contested, and some high-profile claims about fungal networks and plant learning have failed replication
leading_hypotheses: Calcium and electrical wave signaling; volatile chemical communication; mycorrhizal nutrient exchange without intentional communication; overinterpretation of signaling as cognition
mainstream_view: Signaling is established science; plant cognition and the wood-wide web narrative are contested and partly unsupported
testable_prediction: Carefully blinded replication of plant habituation and inter-plant resource transfer experiments
key_evidence_or_cases: Darwin on root behavior; Gagliano Mimosa habituation (contested); 2023 critical review of mycorrhizal network claims
implication_if_solved: Would redraw the boundary of what counts as behavior

observation_summary: Colonies abruptly lose adult workers that fly off and do not return, leaving brood and stores behind
why_it_resists_explanation: Multiple stressors act together and the characteristic sign (missing bees rather than dead bees) is hard to study since the bees disappear
leading_hypotheses: Varroa mite plus deformed wing virus; neonicotinoid sublethal navigation impairment; Nosema infection; nutritional stress from monoculture; synergistic multifactorial cause
mainstream_view: Now generally attributed to interacting stressors with Varroa and viruses central; the acute CCD syndrome itself is less reported since 2013
testable_prediction: Removing specific stressor combinations experimentally should prevent abandonment
key_evidence_or_cases: US CCD surveys 2006-2013; Varroa-virus load correlation; neonicotinoid homing-failure field trials
implication_if_solved: Would protect pollination services worth hundreds of billions annually

observation_summary: Groups of healthy whales and dolphins strand together and often re-strand after rescue
why_it_resists_explanation: Causes likely differ per event, and post-mortem evidence is degraded; social cohesion confounds individual cause
leading_hypotheses: Mid-frequency naval sonar causing decompression-like injury in beaked whales; geomagnetic anomaly navigation errors; following a sick leader; bathymetric traps; parasitic infection of inner ear; solar-storm disruption of magnetic navigation
mainstream_view: Sonar link established for beaked whales; most other strandings remain unexplained individually
testable_prediction: Stranding rates should correlate with geomagnetic storm indices and naval exercise schedules
key_evidence_or_cases: Bahamas 2000 sonar stranding with necropsies; Tasmania 2020 pilot whale stranding of ~470 animals; gas bubble lesion studies
implication_if_solved: Would allow prevention via operational restrictions

observation_summary: A single whale call at an unusually high 52 Hz has been tracked for decades, matching no known species pattern and apparently unanswered
why_it_resists_explanation: The animal has never been seen, so species identity cannot be confirmed from acoustics alone
leading_hypotheses: A malformed or hybrid blue-fin whale; an unusual individual blue whale; a small group rather than one animal (multi-hydrophone data suggests more than one)
mainstream_view: Accepted as a real recurring acoustic signature; identity unknown
testable_prediction: Visual confirmation during a tracked vocalization would resolve species identity
key_evidence_or_cases: US Navy SOSUS recordings since 1989; 2010 multi-sensor detections suggesting multiple callers
implication_if_solved: Would document a hybrid or unrecognized cetacean lineage

locus: Indian Ocean and other tropical seas
observation_summary: Vast areas of ocean up to 100000 square kilometers glow steadily white for nights, visible from orbit
why_it_resists_explanation: Events are rare, remote and unpredictable, so almost no ship has ever sampled one during the glow
leading_hypotheses: Dense Vibrio harveyi populations coupled to algal blooms with quorum-sensing-triggered continuous luminescence
mainstream_view: Real and now satellite-confirmed; biology and trigger conditions poorly characterized
testable_prediction: Targeted sampling guided by satellite detection should confirm the organism and trigger
key_evidence_or_cases: Over 230 historical mariner reports; 1995 SS Lima event confirmed in satellite data 2005; Day-Night Band detections 2019-2022
implication_if_solved: Would reveal a huge episodic microbial process in the ocean

observation_summary: Hydrophone arrays recorded loud, unidentified low-frequency sounds including Bloop, Julia, Slow Down, Train and Upsweep
why_it_resists_explanation: Sources are remote, transient and non-repeating in some cases, with no simultaneous visual or seismic confirmation
leading_hypotheses: Icequakes and iceberg calving (confirmed for Bloop and likely Julia and Train); submarine volcanic activity (Upsweep); seafloor processes not yet identified
mainstream_view: Bloop explained as icequake by NOAA; Upsweep and Slow Down remain less certain but are considered geophysical
testable_prediction: Correlating detections with satellite iceberg tracking should resolve remaining cases
key_evidence_or_cases: NOAA Equatorial Pacific Ocean autonomous hydrophone array recordings 1991-2005
implication_if_solved: Would complete the catalogue of natural ocean sound sources

locus: Taos Bristol Windsor Largs and dozens of other sites
observation_summary: A small percentage of residents in specific areas report a persistent low-frequency throbbing hum that most people cannot hear and instruments rarely capture
why_it_resists_explanation: Field measurements usually find no matching acoustic signal at the reported level, yet sufferers report it consistently, with onset location-dependent
leading_hypotheses: Industrial and compressor-station infrasound; otoacoustic emissions and spontaneous internal signal perception; standing waves in buildings; VLF radio or electromagnetic sensitivity (unsupported); heightened auditory sensitivity in a subset of listeners
mainstream_view: Treated as a real perceptual phenomenon of mostly environmental or physiological origin; no single cause for all sites
testable_prediction: Blinded on-off trials of candidate industrial sources at affected sites should track reports
key_evidence_or_cases: Taos Hum 1993 congressional investigation with instrumented null result; Windsor Hum traced to a blast furnace in Michigan; Bristol Hum 1970s
implication_if_solved: Would resolve a genuine health complaint for thousands of people

locus: Seneca Lake Ganges Delta Belgium North Sea coasts
observation_summary: Unexplained cannon-like booms with no visible source and often no seismic or weather signal, documented for centuries under local names
why_it_resists_explanation: They are brief, unpredictable and usually unrecorded by instruments, so source localization is rarely possible
leading_hypotheses: Distant thunder refracted by atmospheric temperature inversions; ocean-wave or coastal methane release; sonic booms misattributed; small earthquakes with poor coupling; shallow gas venting
mainstream_view: Mostly considered an acoustic propagation and geological grab-bag rather than one phenomenon
testable_prediction: Dense infrasound arrays at a chronic site should localize sources
key_evidence_or_cases: Seneca Guns New York and Carolina coast; Barisal Guns Bengal; Belgian mistpouffers; Lake Cayuga reports
implication_if_solved: Would attribute a centuries-old nuisance to concrete physical processes

observation_summary: Luminous phenomena including flashes, glows and flame-like columns are reported before and during some earthquakes, with photographic and video records
why_it_resists_explanation: They are rare, unpredictable and most reports lack instrumentation; no laboratory process reproduces the scale reported
leading_hypotheses: Stress-activated positive hole charge carriers in igneous rock (Freund); piezoelectric discharge; methane release and ignition; electrical arcing from damaged infrastructure misattributed; triboluminescence in fault gouge
mainstream_view: Increasingly accepted as real after 2014 catalogue of 65 vetted cases; mechanism unsettled
testable_prediction: Instrumented fault zones should record coincident electromagnetic anomalies before events
key_evidence_or_cases: Pisco Peru 2007 video; L Aquila 2009 reports; Tagish Lake; 1965-67 Matsushiro swarm photographs
implication_if_solved: Would possibly yield a short-term earthquake precursor

observation_summary: Despite dense instrumentation nobody can reliably predict the time, place and magnitude of specific earthquakes
why_it_resists_explanation: Rupture nucleation may be inherently sensitive to unobservable small-scale conditions, making prediction possibly impossible in principle
