leading_hypotheses: Deterministic chaos making prediction fundamentally impossible; undiscovered precursors in electromagnetics, radon, or slow slip; machine learning on dense arrays
mainstream_view: Mainstream view is that reliable short-term prediction is currently impossible and may be impossible in principle; forecasting probabilities is feasible
testable_prediction: A validated precursor must show prospective skill above a time-varying baseline, which no method has achieved
key_evidence_or_cases: Failed Parkfield prediction experiment; VAN method controversy; Haicheng 1975 success not reproducible; L Aquila trial of scientists
implication_if_solved: Would save hundreds of thousands of lives

locus: Subduction zones down to 700 km depth
observation_summary: Earthquakes occur at depths where pressure should make rock deform plastically rather than fracture brittlely
why_it_resists_explanation: Normal frictional failure is suppressed at those pressures, so another instability must operate, and the depths cannot be sampled directly
leading_hypotheses: Transformational faulting via olivine to spinel phase change; dehydration embrittlement from hydrous minerals; thermal runaway shear instability
mainstream_view: Recognized as a real paradox; several mechanisms partly supported by lab work
testable_prediction: High-pressure deformation experiments should reproduce acoustic emissions matching deep event source parameters
key_evidence_or_cases: Wadati deep seismicity 1927; 2013 Okhotsk Sea M8.3 at 609 km; laboratory anticrack experiments
implication_if_solved: Would explain the deepest limit of brittle Earth behavior

phenomenon: Earth inner core structure and rotation
observation_summary: The inner core is seismically anisotropic, hemispherically asymmetric, may contain an innermost core, and appears to rotate at a slightly different rate that has recently reversed relative to the mantle
why_it_resists_explanation: Observations rely on sparse repeating earthquake pairs and seismic ray paths through a region nobody can sample, so interpretations are contested
leading_hypotheses: Differential rotation with multidecadal oscillation; crystal alignment from solidification texture; inner core translation and melting-freezing asymmetry; the apparent rotation changes are instead inner core boundary shape changes
mainstream_view: Anisotropy and asymmetry accepted; rotation story actively disputed with multiple competing readings of the same data
testable_prediction: Longer seismic time series should distinguish rotation from boundary deformation
key_evidence_or_cases: Lehmann 1936 discovery; Song and Richards 1996 differential rotation; 2023 Yang and Song reversal claim; PKIKP travel-time studies
implication_if_solved: Would illuminate the geodynamo that shields the biosphere

phenomenon: Geomagnetic reversal timing and the South Atlantic Anomaly
observation_summary: The magnetic field reverses polarity at irregular intervals from tens of thousands to tens of millions of years, and a large weak patch over the South Atlantic is growing
why_it_resists_explanation: Dynamo simulations reproduce reversals statistically but cannot predict them; the core state is only indirectly observable
leading_hypotheses: Chaotic dynamo with no predictable schedule; core-mantle boundary heat flux control; reverse flux patches at the core surface as reversal precursors; the anomaly as a recurring regional feature not a precursor
mainstream_view: Reversals are well documented; predictability is essentially absent
testable_prediction: Satellite magnetic monitoring should show whether reverse flux patches grow monotonically toward a reversal
key_evidence_or_cases: Matuyama 1926 reversal discovery; seafloor magnetic stripes; Swarm satellite SAA mapping; Laschamp excursion 41000 years ago
implication_if_solved: Would allow forecasting of a major space-weather and satellite risk

observation_summary: Highly regular hexagonally spaced bare circles in grassland, meters across, persisting for decades
why_it_resists_explanation: Two main explanations fit different sites, and the pattern formation mechanism has been debated for a century with field evidence supporting both camps
leading_hypotheses: Sand termite herbivory creating bare patches (Juergens); plant self-organization under water competition producing Turing patterns (Getzin, Tschinkel); combination of both
mainstream_view: Real and well measured; the cause remains actively contested with recent water-uptake studies favoring self-organization
testable_prediction: Excluding termites while measuring soil moisture should separate the hypotheses definitively
key_evidence_or_cases: Namibian termite nest surveys; 2022 Getzin soil moisture and root measurements; Australian hard-crust findings
implication_if_solved: Would validate Turing pattern theory in a macroscopic ecosystem

phenomenon: Patterned ground and periglacial stone circles
observation_summary: Stones self-sort into polygons, stripes and circles on flat ground with striking geometric regularity
why_it_resists_explanation: Processes act over decades to millennia and are hard to observe directly, though lab and model work reproduces much of the pattern
leading_hypotheses: Frost heave and needle-ice sorting; convective circulation in freeze-thaw soils; differential thermal contraction cracking
mainstream_view: Largely explained by self-organized frost sorting; specific geometries still modeled imperfectly
testable_prediction: Lab freeze-thaw cells should reproduce the full range of observed geometries from one model
key_evidence_or_cases: Spitsbergen stone circles; Kessler and Werner 2003 self-organization model
implication_if_solved: Would complete the physics of cold-climate landforms

observation_summary: Thin dark manganese-rich coatings form on desert rocks over thousands of years, enriched in manganese far above the local dust and rock
why_it_resists_explanation: The rate is far too slow to observe directly, and attempts to culture a responsible organism have not clearly succeeded
leading_hypotheses: Microbial manganese oxidation concentrating Mn from dust; purely abiotic water-mediated concentration; silica gel-mediated accretion (Perry)
mainstream_view: Real and well characterized chemically; formation mechanism still debated between biotic and abiotic
testable_prediction: Sterile versus inoculated field plots over decades should show differential varnish formation
key_evidence_or_cases: Petroglyph dating via varnish; Mn enrichment factors up to 50x; Perry silica gel model
implication_if_solved: Would provide a reliable surface-exposure dating method and a Mars biosignature control

observation_summary: An abrupt return to glacial conditions coincided with a black mat layer, megafauna extinctions and Clovis culture disruption; some claim an impact or airburst caused it
why_it_resists_explanation: Proposed impact markers (nanodiamonds, microspherules, platinum) have failed independent replication in several studies, while proponents report new confirming sites
leading_hypotheses: Comet fragment airburst or impact; meltwater pulse from Lake Agassiz disrupting Atlantic circulation (mainstream); volcanic forcing; coincidence of multiple factors
mainstream_view: Mainstream favors ocean-circulation disruption; the impact hypothesis remains a vocal minority position with contested evidence
testable_prediction: Independent blinded analysis of the same stratigraphic layers for impact markers
key_evidence_or_cases: Greenland platinum anomaly; Hiawatha crater discovery (dated too old); failed nanodiamond replications; Abu Hureyra glass claims
implication_if_solved: Would change the risk model for cosmic impacts in human history

observation_summary: Hundreds of thousands of elliptical depressions with aligned long axes and raised rims across the coastal plain
why_it_resists_explanation: Dating gives a wide range of ages inconsistent with a single event, while the geometric regularity invites a single-cause explanation
leading_hypotheses: Aeolian and lacustrine reworking of shallow basins by prevailing winds during the Pleistocene (mainstream); impact or airburst ejecta (rejected by dating and absence of shock features)
mainstream_view: Consensus is wind-and-water modification of pre-existing basins; the impact idea is considered refuted
testable_prediction: Optically stimulated luminescence dating across many bays should continue to show staggered formation ages
key_evidence_or_cases: Aerial photography surveys 1930s; OSL dating studies; absence of shocked quartz
implication_if_solved: Would finalize a long-running geomorphology dispute

observation_summary: A 240-page illustrated codex in an unknown script with statistical properties resembling natural language but matching no known language or cipher
why_it_resists_explanation: The script has word-length distributions and entropy unlike simple ciphers or random gibberish, yet no decipherment has survived peer scrutiny
leading_hypotheses: Unknown natural language in an invented script; an abjad or shorthand encoding of a known language; an elaborate glossolalic or constructed-language hoax for sale; a steganographic cipher
mainstream_view: The object is genuine and carbon-dated to 1404-1438; every proposed decipherment has been rejected
testable_prediction: A valid decipherment must produce consistent meaningful text across all sections including the unillustrated ones
key_evidence_or_cases: Beinecke MS 408; vellum radiocarbon dating 2009; Zipf-law-like statistics; dozens of failed solutions
implication_if_solved: Would recover a lost body of 15th century knowledge or settle a famous hoax

observation_summary: About 1400 inscriptions in a syllabary whose sign values are partly known from the related Linear B, yet the underlying language is unidentified
why_it_resists_explanation: The corpus is small and consists mostly of short administrative lists, giving too little context to reconstruct grammar; the language has no known relatives
leading_hypotheses: A pre-Greek Aegean language isolate; an Anatolian Indo-European language; a Semitic language; a language related to Etruscan or Lycian
mainstream_view: Sign values largely transferable from Linear B; the language itself remains undeciphered
testable_prediction: A substantially longer bilingual or narrative text would likely crack it
key_evidence_or_cases: Hagia Triada tablets; Linear B decipherment by Ventris in 1952 as the reference point
implication_if_solved: Would open the written record of Minoan civilization

observation_summary: About 26 wooden objects bear a glyph system; whether it is true writing, proto-writing or mnemonic is unresolved
why_it_resists_explanation: The corpus totals only a few thousand glyphs, the knowledgeable population was destroyed by slave raiding and disease before recording, and provenance is poor
leading_hypotheses: Logosyllabic writing of Rapa Nui language; mnemonic or calendrical device; genealogical and lunar-calendar content (partially supported for one tablet)
mainstream_view: Genuine artifacts, with 2024 radiocarbon dating one tablet possibly pre-contact; undeciphered
testable_prediction: Discovery of additional tablets or a transcription by a literate informant would be decisive
key_evidence_or_cases: Mamari tablet lunar calendar identification; 2024 radiocarbon dates on Rome tablets
implication_if_solved: Would prove independent invention of writing in Polynesia

observation_summary: Thousands of short inscriptions averaging five signs, with about 400 signs, resisting decipherment for 150 years
why_it_resists_explanation: Texts are too short for internal reconstruction, there is no bilingual key, and even whether it encodes language is disputed
leading_hypotheses: Dravidian language ancestor; Indo-Aryan (politically charged, weakly supported); non-linguistic emblem or tag system (Farmer, Sproat, Witzel); Munda or unknown isolate
mainstream_view: Genuine corpus; no accepted decipherment and active dispute over whether it is writing at all
testable_prediction: Conditional entropy analyses suggest linguistic structure; a long text or bilingual seal would settle it
key_evidence_or_cases: Mohenjo-daro and Harappa seals; Dholavira signboard; Rao et al 2009 entropy study
implication_if_solved: Would open the records of one of the largest Bronze Age civilizations

observation_summary: A fired clay disc stamped with 241 tokens of 45 distinct signs in a spiral, the earliest known movable-type-like artifact, with no parallel corpus
why_it_resists_explanation: It is a single unique object, so internal decipherment is statistically impossible and there is nothing to compare it to
leading_hypotheses: Minoan prayer or hymn; a calendar; a board game; a modern forgery (minority view, broadly rejected)
mainstream_view: Generally accepted as authentic; undecipherable in practice with a single object
testable_prediction: Discovery of another artifact with the same script would transform the problem
key_evidence_or_cases: The disc in Heraklion Museum; the Arkalochori Axe with possibly related signs
implication_if_solved: Would add a text to the Minoan corpus

observation_summary: The fourth section of a sculpture cipher, 97 characters, remains unsolved after 35 years despite three hints released by the artist
why_it_resists_explanation: The short length limits statistical attack, and the encryption method is unknown and possibly layered with a masking step
leading_hypotheses: A transposition over an unidentified polyalphabetic layer; a one-off artist-designed system; a scheme requiring a physical key at the site
mainstream_view: A genuine unsolved puzzle; K1 through K3 solved in 1998-1999
testable_prediction: The plaintext is known by the artist, so any solution is immediately verifiable
key_evidence_or_cases: Sanborn clues BERLIN CLOCK NORTHEAST; Gillogly and Stein solutions of K1-K3
implication_if_solved: Would close the most famous unsolved public cipher

observation_summary: Three ciphertexts allegedly locating a buried treasure; one is solved using the Declaration of Independence as a key, two remain unsolved
why_it_resists_explanation: The unsolved texts may use lost key documents, or the whole thing may be a 19th century hoax, and there is no way to distinguish these
leading_hypotheses: Book ciphers with unidentified key texts; a deliberate hoax built around one genuinely encoded document; a hoax entirely
mainstream_view: Most cryptographers and historians lean hoax; statistical analyses of the unsolved texts are inconclusive
testable_prediction: Identification of the key text would decode them; statistical tests for hoax structure have been attempted
key_evidence_or_cases: Beale Papers pamphlet 1885; Cipher 2 decoded via Declaration of Independence; Gillogly string anomalies
implication_if_solved: Would resolve a famous Americana mystery

observation_summary: An 87-character note of squiggle symbols sent by Edward Elgar to a young friend, never deciphered
why_it_resists_explanation: It is extremely short, likely contains private references or a nonstandard mapping, and may not be in plain English
leading_hypotheses: A simple substitution with phonetic or shorthand spelling; a musical cipher; a private joke that is deliberately unreadable
mainstream_view: Genuine document; no accepted solution
testable_prediction: A convincing solution would produce natural-sounding text consistent with the letter context
key_evidence_or_cases: The letter to Dora Penny; Elgar Birthplace Museum archives
implication_if_solved: Would decode a note by a major composer

observation_summary: Two short ciphertexts from the Zodiac killer remain unsolved after the 408 and 340 ciphers were cracked
why_it_resists_explanation: Z13 is only 13 characters, far below the length needed for unique solution, so many plausible plaintexts fit
leading_hypotheses: A name in a homophonic substitution; deliberate nonsense; keyed to a scheme used nowhere else
mainstream_view: Considered likely unsolvable due to length; Z408 solved 1969 and Z340 solved 2020
testable_prediction: Any proposed solution for Z13 cannot be uniquely verified without outside corroboration
key_evidence_or_cases: Z408 solved by Harden couple; Z340 solved by Oranchak Blake and Eker 2020
implication_if_solved: Could name a serial killer

observation_summary: A geared bronze analog computer predicting eclipses and planetary positions with no comparable surviving device for over a thousand years
why_it_resists_explanation: The device implies a mature engineering tradition for which there is essentially no other archaeological evidence; how the knowledge was lost is unexplained
leading_hypotheses: A tradition of such instruments existed and simply did not survive in the archaeological record; Archimedean and Rhodian school lineage; a near-unique commission
mainstream_view: The device itself is now well reconstructed via CT imaging; the technological context and its disappearance are the open part
testable_prediction: Discovery of another geared device would establish a tradition rather than an isolate
key_evidence_or_cases: Antikythera Mechanism Research Project CT scans; Saros and Metonic gear train reconstruction
implication_if_solved: Would rewrite the history of mechanical computation

observation_summary: Over 100 hollow bronze twelve-faced objects with holes of varying sizes and knobbed vertices, with no mention in any surviving Roman text
why_it_resists_explanation: No written reference exists, they are absent from the Mediterranean core, and the find contexts are varied including graves and hoards
leading_hypotheses: Knitting gauges for glove fingers; surveying or range-finding devices; candle holders; religious or divinatory objects; gaming pieces; craftsman gauge standards
mainstream_view: Authentic and well catalogued; function unknown, with ritual use currently the most commonly favored guess
testable_prediction: Find-context analysis across all specimens should correlate with a single functional class
key_evidence_or_cases: Norton Disney dodecahedron 2023; Gallo-Roman distribution map
implication_if_solved: Would illuminate daily or ritual life in the Roman provinces

phenomenon: Gobekli Tepe purpose and deliberate burial
observation_summary: Monumental carved stone enclosures built by pre-agricultural people, then apparently deliberately backfilled
why_it_resists_explanation: It predates pottery, agriculture and metal, inverting the assumed sequence of civilization; the backfilling motive is unknown and now partly disputed
leading_hypotheses: Ritual and feasting center predating agriculture; a settlement with domestic as well as ritual structures (recent excavations); gradual slope-wash infill rather than intentional burial; a monument whose construction drove the shift to farming
mainstream_view: Authenticity and dates secure; interpretation shifting as excavation continues and as Karahan Tepe and other sites are dug
testable_prediction: Continued excavation of the unexcavated 95 percent should distinguish ritual-only from settlement use
key_evidence_or_cases: Schmidt excavations from 1995; Karahan Tepe and the Tas Tepeler sites; T-shaped pillar iconography
implication_if_solved: Would reframe the origin of agriculture and monumental religion

observation_summary: 2.3 million blocks averaging 2.5 tons placed to sub-centimeter alignment in roughly 20 years, with the internal ramp and lifting system undocumented
why_it_resists_explanation: No contemporary construction manual survives; the internal logistics must be inferred from quarry marks, worker village evidence and physical constraints
leading_hypotheses: Straight and spiral external ramps; internal ramp (Houdin); water-assisted transport along a now-dry Khufu branch of the Nile; levering and sledges with wetted sand; cast-stone blocks (rejected)
mainstream_view: Broad consensus that it was built by organized Egyptian labor with ramps and sledges; the specific method is unresolved, and no credible scholar invokes non-human builders
testable_prediction: Muon tomography and ongoing ScanPyramids work should reveal internal voids consistent with a specific ramp type
key_evidence_or_cases: Wadi al-Jarf papyri logging limestone shipments; Khufu branch sediment cores 2022; ScanPyramids Big Void 2017; Lehner worker village
implication_if_solved: Would complete our picture of Old Kingdom engineering and administration

observation_summary: Andesite and sandstone blocks cut with flat planes, interior right angles and repeated standardized modules, some weighing over 100 tons
why_it_resists_explanation: Andesite is very hard, and the precision implies systematic templating with tools that have not been recovered in quantity
leading_hypotheses: Hammerstone and sand abrasion with templates; bronze-copper-arsenic chisels (Tiwanaku did have arsenical bronze); scribe-and-grind techniques; poured geopolymer (rejected by petrography)
mainstream_view: Archaeologically explicable with stone and bronze tools plus labor organization; details of technique still being reconstructed; no evidence for exotic explanations
testable_prediction: Experimental archaeology should reproduce the H-blocks with documented Tiwanaku tool kits
key_evidence_or_cases: Protzen and Nair tool-mark studies; arsenical bronze finds; quarry sites at Copacabana
implication_if_solved: Would document a sophisticated Andean stone industry

phenomenon: Easter Island moai transport and societal change
observation_summary: Nearly 900 statues up to 82 tons were moved kilometers from quarry to platforms, and the population underwent major change by European contact
why_it_resists_explanation: Oral tradition says the statues walked, and the collapse narrative has been substantially overturned, leaving causality contested
leading_hypotheses: Upright walking with ropes (demonstrated experimentally); sledges and log rollers; rat-driven deforestation plus European disease and slave raiding rather than self-inflicted ecocide
mainstream_view: Walking transport has been demonstrated and is now widely accepted; the ecocide collapse narrative is largely rejected by current archaeology
testable_prediction: Paleodemographic and land-use data should continue to show sustainable population until contact
key_evidence_or_cases: Lipo and Hunt walking experiments 2012; obsidian hydration population estimates; Rano Raraku quarry statues
implication_if_solved: Would correct a widely taught but wrong story about societal collapse

observation_summary: Hundreds of giant geoglyphs including animals and kilometers-long straight lines, best appreciated from the air
why_it_resists_explanation: The builders left no written explanation and the figures serve no obvious practical function; multiple uses likely overlapped across 1000 years
leading_hypotheses: Ritual pathways walked in procession; water and irrigation markers; astronomical alignments (weakly supported); clan or lineage markers; pilgrimage routes to Cahuachi
mainstream_view: Ritual and water-related interpretations dominate; no exotic explanation is taken seriously
testable_prediction: Machine-learning surveys adding hundreds of new figures should reveal spatial relationships to water sources and paths
key_evidence_or_cases: Reiche surveys; Cahuachi ceremonial center; 2022-2024 AI-assisted discovery of 300+ new figures
implication_if_solved: Would explain a massive communal ritual investment

observation_summary: A sequence of monuments over 1500 years, with bluestones moved 250 km from Wales and an Altar Stone now traced to northeast Scotland 750 km away
why_it_resists_explanation: Pre-literate builders left no explanation; the 2024 Altar Stone provenance result overturns the previous model and has no accepted transport mechanism
leading_hypotheses: Solar calendar and solstice ritual site; healing or ancestral burial center; a unification monument assembled from stones of distant communities; sea and river transport of the Scottish stone
mainstream_view: Astronomical alignment is undisputed; social function and the Scottish Altar Stone transport are genuinely open
testable_prediction: Further isotopic sourcing and coastal archaeology should identify a transport route
key_evidence_or_cases: Solstice alignments; Preseli bluestone quarries; 2024 Altar Stone Orcadian Basin provenance; Durrington Walls feasting evidence
implication_if_solved: Would reveal the scale of Neolithic social organization across Britain

phenomenon: Bronze Age collapse and the Sea Peoples
observation_summary: Within about 50 years, nearly every major eastern Mediterranean state collapsed, writing systems were lost, and raiders called the Sea Peoples appear in Egyptian records
why_it_resists_explanation: Egyptian sources are propagandistic and name groups whose identities cannot be matched to archaeology; causes are multiple and simultaneous
leading_hypotheses: Systems collapse of interdependent palace economies; prolonged drought shown in pollen and isotope records; earthquake storm; migration and raiding; new military technologies and tactics; combination cascade
mainstream_view: Multi-causal systems collapse is the consensus frame; the Sea Peoples identity remains unresolved
testable_prediction: Further paleoclimate and destruction-layer dating should order the causal chain
key_evidence_or_cases: Medinet Habu reliefs; Ugarit destruction and final letters; Dead Sea and Soreq Cave drought proxies; Hittite grain pleas
implication_if_solved: Would provide a case study in cascading civilizational collapse

observation_summary: A linen cloth bears a faint full-length negative human image with no detected pigment or brushwork, confined to the topmost fibers
why_it_resists_explanation: No fully satisfactory reproduction of all image properties has been published; radiocarbon dating to 1260-1390 conflicts with some other analyses and sampling is contested
leading_hypotheses: Medieval artistic technique using bas-relief rubbing or acid pigment; Maillard reaction between body amines and carbohydrate coating; corona discharge; radiation burst (not physically supported); contact and diffusion imprint
mainstream_view: Radiocarbon dating places the cloth in the 14th century, which most scientists accept; the image mechanism remains without an agreed full reproduction
testable_prediction: A technique reproducing superficiality, negativity, three-dimensional encoding and lack of pigment simultaneously would close the case
key_evidence_or_cases: 1988 radiocarbon dating 1260-1390; STURP 1978 report; 2022 wide-angle X-ray scattering claim of ancient date; Garlaschelli 2009 partial reproduction
implication_if_solved: Would resolve one of the most studied artifacts in history

observation_summary: Nine experienced hikers cut their way out of their tent at night in extreme cold and died scattered, some with severe internal injuries and no external wounds
why_it_resists_explanation: Soviet records were incomplete and partly classified, radiation traces on some clothing were never explained, and the injuries are unusual
leading_hypotheses: Slab avalanche plus paradoxical undressing and hypothermia (2021 Nature Communications modeling); katabatic wind; infrasound-induced panic from a Karman vortex; military weapons test; the radiation traces from occupational contamination of one hiker
mainstream_view: The 2021 slab-avalanche model is now the leading explanation and is accepted by many; some details including the radiation remain unaddressed
testable_prediction: Field measurement of slab stability on that slope under similar conditions supports or weakens the model
key_evidence_or_cases: 1959 criminal case file; 2019 Russian reinvestigation concluding avalanche; Gaume and Puzrin 2021 modeling
implication_if_solved: Would close a famous case and validate slab-avalanche models on shallow slopes

observation_summary: An airburst flattened over 2000 square kilometers of forest with no crater and no recovered meteorite fragments of certain origin
why_it_resists_explanation: The region was remote and not surveyed for 13 years, so the impactor type cannot be confirmed from recovered material
leading_hypotheses: Stony asteroid airburst at 5 to 10 km altitude (mainstream); cometary fragment; a grazing near-miss body that re-exited the atmosphere (2020 proposal); no exotic explanation needed
mainstream_view: Airburst of a natural object is consensus; the composition and trajectory are debated
testable_prediction: Isotopic analysis of peat layers and tree resin from 1908 should constrain impactor composition
key_evidence_or_cases: Kulik 1927 expedition; butterfly-shaped treefall pattern; Lake Cheko impact-crater hypothesis (disputed); global barograph records
implication_if_solved: Would calibrate airburst risk from small asteroids

locus: South Atlantic near Prince Edward Islands
observation_summary: A US satellite detected a characteristic double flash consistent with a nuclear test, but no debris was conclusively identified and no state admitted it
why_it_resists_explanation: The satellite sensor had a known false-alarm mode, hydroacoustic and radionuclide evidence was ambiguous, and political pressure shaped the official inquiry
leading_hypotheses: A South African or Israeli nuclear test; a micrometeoroid impact on the satellite producing a spurious double flash; a lightning superbolt; a legitimate detection suppressed for policy reasons
mainstream_view: Technical consensus has shifted toward a genuine nuclear detonation; officially unresolved
testable_prediction: Declassification of remaining records and reanalysis of iodine-131 in Australian sheep thyroids
key_evidence_or_cases: Vela 6911 bhangmeter data; Ruina panel 1980 report; Arecibo ionospheric disturbance; sheep thyroid iodine traces
implication_if_solved: Would document a clandestine nuclear test and reshape proliferation history

observation_summary: A Boeing 777 with 239 people deviated from course, flew for seven hours after communications ceased, and has never been located despite the largest search in aviation history
why_it_resists_explanation: The aircraft left primary radar coverage, the only data is a series of satellite handshake frequency offsets, and the ocean floor in the search region is poorly mapped
leading_hypotheses: Deliberate diversion by a person in the cockpit; progressive hypoxia incapacitation after a cabin event; electrical fire disabling systems; the search zone derived from Inmarsat data is slightly wrong
mainstream_view: Officially unresolved; the ATSB and independent analysts largely agree on the broad flight path from satellite data
testable_prediction: Refined drift modeling of recovered flaperon debris plus WSPR-based path analysis should narrow the seabed search
key_evidence_or_cases: Inmarsat burst frequency offset analysis; 33 pieces of debris on western Indian Ocean shores; 2025 resumed Ocean Infinity search
implication_if_solved: Would explain the loss of 239 lives and improve aircraft tracking rules

observation_summary: A seaworthy brigantine was found sailing unmanned with cargo mostly intact, one lifeboat missing, and the crew never seen again
why_it_resists_explanation: No survivors, no log entries after a certain date, and contemporary investigation produced no determination
leading_hypotheses: Panic abandonment after a cargo alcohol vapor explosion scare; feared sinking from a pump malfunction and flooded hold; waterspout; abandonment during a calm followed by loss of the lifeboat; insurance fraud or mutiny (no evidence)
mainstream_view: Treated as a historical maritime mystery with mundane leading explanations; no exotic explanation needed
testable_prediction: Nothing new is likely to surface; the hypotheses remain unfalsifiable at this distance
key_evidence_or_cases: Gibraltar Admiralty court inquiry; nine of 1701 alcohol barrels found empty; missing chronometer and sextant
implication_if_solved: Would close the archetypal ghost-ship case

observation_summary: Three lighthouse keepers vanished from a remote island leaving a half-eaten meal story (later shown apocryphal), damaged west landing equipment and no bodies
why_it_resists_explanation: The island was isolated, the inspection occurred days later, and physical evidence was limited
leading_hypotheses: Two keepers swept away by a rogue wave while securing equipment, with the third lost attempting rescue; storm surge at the west landing; no evidence for abduction or murder
mainstream_view: The rogue wave at the west landing is the standard explanation and fits the damage pattern
testable_prediction: Wave modeling of the west landing geometry supports the scenario
key_evidence_or_cases: Superintendent Muirhead 1900 report; damaged railings and displaced boulder at west landing
implication_if_solved: Would close a famous disappearance with ordinary physics

observation_summary: Earhart and Noonan vanished on the Howland Island leg of a round-the-world flight with no confirmed wreckage ever found
why_it_resists_explanation: The search area is enormous and deep, radio evidence is fragmentary, and candidate artifacts have been contested
leading_hypotheses: Fuel exhaustion and crash near Howland Island (mainstream); landing and death on Nikumaroro; capture by Japanese forces (no credible evidence)
mainstream_view: Crash and sink near Howland is the leading view; Nikumaroro remains a minority hypothesis
testable_prediction: Deep-sea sonar surveys of the Howland approach could find the Electra; the 2024 Taraia Object imaging claim awaits verification
key_evidence_or_cases: Itasca radio logs; Nikumaroro bone and artifact claims; Deep Sea Vision 2024 sonar anomaly
implication_if_solved: Would close a landmark aviation mystery

observation_summary: A 165-meter US Navy collier with 306 aboard vanished without distress signal or wreckage, the largest non-combat loss of life in US Navy history
why_it_resists_explanation: No wreck has ever been found, so structural failure cannot be verified
leading_hypotheses: Catastrophic structural failure from manganese ore cargo liquefaction and overloading; capsizing in a storm; boiler explosion; enemy action (no evidence)
mainstream_view: Cargo-related structural failure is the leading explanation; officially unexplained
testable_prediction: Locating the wreck would confirm a hull-failure signature
key_evidence_or_cases: Navy board of inquiry; later losses of sister ships Proteus and Nereus to similar causes
notable_names: Worley; Navy History and Heritage Command
implication_if_solved: Would confirm a design flaw that killed hundreds across three ships

observation_summary: Navy F/A-18 crews and the USS Princeton radar reported an object with no visible propulsion holding position and then departing rapidly, recorded on targeting pod video
why_it_resists_explanation: Sensor data is limited, calibration for unknown objects is poor, and the available video does not establish range or absolute velocity
leading_hypotheses: Sensor and parallax artifacts plus misperceived distant aircraft or balloon; classified US or foreign platform; atmospheric optical effect; genuinely unexplained flight characteristics
mainstream_view: US government acknowledges the event occurred and is unidentified; no evidence supports extraterrestrial origin and skeptical sensor analyses explain much of the video
testable_prediction: High-quality multi-sensor data with calibrated range would allow kinematic reconstruction
key_evidence_or_cases: FLIR1 video released 2017; Princeton SPY-1 radar tracks; AATIP and AARO reviews
implication_if_solved: Would either reveal an unknown aerial technology or close a high-profile case

observation_summary: Navy ATFLIR videos show an object apparently rotating and another apparently moving fast over water
why_it_resists_explanation: The imagery lacks range information, and the rotation is consistent with gimbal-mounted optics artifacts while the apparent speed resolves to slow motion once parallax is computed
leading_hypotheses: ATFLIR gimbal roll artifact and infrared glare for GIMBAL; a slow-moving balloon or bird at close range for GOFAST; unknown craft
mainstream_view: Technical analyses of GOFAST show the object is slow once parallax is accounted for; GIMBAL rotation is plausibly an optical artifact; officially still listed as unidentified
testable_prediction: Release of full sensor telemetry including range would settle both
key_evidence_or_cases: ATFLIR videos released by DoD 2020; Mick West parallax analysis; AARO assessments
implication_if_solved: Would demonstrate how sensor artifacts generate UAP reports

observation_summary: US Air Force personnel near RAF Woodbridge reported lights and a landed craft over three nights, documented in a memo by the deputy base commander
why_it_resists_explanation: Testimony conflicts and changed over decades, physical trace evidence was weak, and candidate mundane sources existed nearby
leading_hypotheses: Orford Ness lighthouse plus a bright meteor and Sirius misidentified; a re-entering Cosmos satellite; a covert aircraft or nuclear incident cover story; genuinely unexplained craft
mainstream_view: Skeptical reconstructions involving the lighthouse and a bright fireball are widely accepted; believers dispute them
testable_prediction: Timing reconstruction against lighthouse rotation and satellite re-entry logs
key_evidence_or_cases: Halt memo 1981; Halt audio tape; Ridpath lighthouse analysis
implication_if_solved: Would show how layered misidentification produces durable legend

observation_summary: Thousands of witnesses reported a large V-formation of lights crossing the state, followed later the same night by a stationary arc of lights
why_it_resists_explanation: Two separate events occurred the same evening and are routinely conflated, and witness estimates of size and distance are unreliable
leading_hypotheses: A formation of A-10 aircraft for the earlier event and military flare drops over the Barry Goldwater Range for the later arc (documented); an unidentified single craft
mainstream_view: The flare explanation for the later event is well supported by range records and videos; the earlier formation is less certainly resolved
testable_prediction: Video analysis showing lights occulted by the Estrella mountain ridge supports the flare account
key_evidence_or_cases: Multiple home videos; Maryland Air National Guard flare drop records; Lynne Kitei documentation
implication_if_solved: Would illustrate how two unrelated events merge into one legend

observation_summary: Hundreds of reports over several months of a silent triangular craft, with two F-16 radar lock attempts in March 1990
why_it_resists_explanation: The radar data had known anomalies, the famous photograph was confessed a hoax in 2011, and no independent corroboration survived
leading_hypotheses: Misidentified aircraft and stars under unusual atmospheric conditions; radar anomalies from temperature inversion; a secret aircraft program; a wave driven by media feedback
mainstream_view: Largely deflated after the photo hoax confession and radar reanalysis; the Belgian Air Force report remained inconclusive
testable_prediction: Reanalysis of the original F-16 radar tapes for inversion signatures
key_evidence_or_cases: Belgian Air Force report 1990; Petit-Rechain photograph hoax confession 2011
implication_if_solved: Would document how a national UFO wave can arise and dissolve

observation_summary: Witnesses reported an acorn-shaped object with band markings recovered by the military after a widely seen fireball
why_it_resists_explanation: Military records were incomplete and a NASA document search produced missing files, fueling suspicion without evidence
leading_hypotheses: Debris from a Soviet Kosmos 96 Venus probe re-entry (timing disputed); a bright meteor with no recovery and embellished witness accounts; a classified US object
mainstream_view: Most analysts favor a meteor with no artifact recovery; the Kosmos 96 timing does not fit well
testable_prediction: Declassification of complete 1965 USAF logistics records
key_evidence_or_cases: 1965 fireball reports across several states; NASA FOIA litigation; Kosmos 96 orbital decay data
implication_if_solved: Would close a Cold War era recovery claim

observation_summary: Livestock found dead with apparently precise excisions of eyes, tongues and reproductive organs, often reported as bloodless
why_it_resists_explanation: Carcasses are usually found days later, so soft-tissue loss patterns are hard to date, and the striking precision claims rarely survive veterinary examination
leading_hypotheses: Normal scavenger predation on soft tissues after death with blowfly and bird feeding producing clean-looking edges; postmortem bloating and blood pooling explaining apparent exsanguination; rare cult activity; covert government sampling (no evidence)
mainstream_view: FBI Operation Animal Mutilation 1980 concluded predation and decomposition; veterinary pathologists broadly agree
testable_prediction: Controlled carcass-exposure studies reproduce the characteristic lesions, and they do
key_evidence_or_cases: Rommel FBI report 1980; Washington State and Alberta veterinary studies; controlled decomposition trials
implication_if_solved: Would permanently settle a persistent rural folklore

observation_summary: Large geometric flattened-crop formations appear overnight, some extremely complex
why_it_resists_explanation: Early claims of impossibility were based on untested assumptions about plant node changes and construction speed
leading_hypotheses: Human construction with planks ropes and GPS layout (confessed and demonstrated repeatedly); a small residue of unexplained simple circles from wind vortices
mainstream_view: Settled as human-made art and hoax; Bower and Chorley confessed in 1991 and teams reproduce complex formations on demand
testable_prediction: Any formation can be reproduced by a documented human team within the same time window, which has been shown many times
key_evidence_or_cases: Doug Bower and Dave Chorley confession 1991; circlemakers commercial formations; node-change claims not replicated
implication_if_solved: Already resolved; serves as a case study in anomalous-claim inflation

observation_summary: Bodies found extensively burned with limited damage to surrounding furnishings and no identified external fire source
why_it_resists_explanation: Cases are discovered after the fact with no witnesses, and investigators historically underestimated the available fuel and burn duration
leading_hypotheses: Wick effect in which clothing ignites subcutaneous fat producing a slow sustained low-flame burn; an identified but overlooked ignition source such as a cigarette or heater; ketosis or alcoholism as predisposing factors (unsupported); no internal spontaneous ignition mechanism exists
mainstream_view: Forensic consensus is the wick effect with an external ignition source; no case requires spontaneous ignition
testable_prediction: Wick-effect experiments with pig carcasses reproduce the observed burn pattern, and they do
key_evidence_or_cases: Mary Reeser 1951 case; BBC QED wick effect demonstration 1989; Michael Faherty 2010 Irish coroner verdict
implication_if_solved: Already largely resolved; illustrates forensic reconstruction of rare fires

observation_summary: Reports of object movement, knocking, and household disturbances centered on a person, often an adolescent
why_it_resists_explanation: Investigations under controlled conditions almost always stop the phenomena, and many famous cases include confessed or caught trickery
leading_hypotheses: Deliberate hoaxing often by a focus child; misperception, infrasound and seismic or plumbing causes; sleep-related experiences; recurrent spontaneous psychokinesis (no accepted evidence)
mainstream_view: No scientifically accepted evidence of any anomalous physical agency; psychological and fraud explanations dominate
testable_prediction: Any genuine case should produce effects under instrumented blinded observation, which has never occurred
key_evidence_or_cases: Enfield case 1977 with caught trickery; Rosenheim case 1967; Columbus Ohio case with on-camera deception
implication_if_solved: Would require revising physics if ever demonstrated; currently a psychology and fraud topic

observation_summary: A substantial minority of people report seeing or sensing a deceased or absent person, sometimes veridically coinciding with that person death
why_it_resists_explanation: Experience reports are subjective, retrospective and subject to coincidence inflation and selective memory; the base rate of coincidences is large
leading_hypotheses: Bereavement hallucinations and grief-related perceptual processes; hypnagogic and hypnopompic imagery; sleep paralysis; pattern completion in low-information environments; actual survival of consciousness (no accepted evidence)
mainstream_view: Treated as a real and common psychological experience; no evidence of external agency
testable_prediction: Prospective registration of crisis apparitions before confirmation of the death would allow statistical testing
key_evidence_or_cases: SPR Census of Hallucinations 1894; bereavement hallucination prevalence studies; sleep paralysis research
implication_if_solved: Would illuminate normal perception under grief and altered states

observation_summary: Patients report vivid structured experiences including out-of-body perspective, tunnel, life review and ineffability during periods of severely compromised brain function
why_it_resists_explanation: The timing of the experience within the arrest cannot be established, memory of the event is formed after resuscitation, and veridical perception claims rarely survive verification
leading_hypotheses: Transient surge of coherent gamma activity at and after cardiac arrest (observed in both rats and humans); hypoxia and hypercapnia; ketamine-like endogenous NMDA blockade; REM intrusion; temporal lobe activation; non-local consciousness (no accepted evidence)
mainstream_view: Experiences are real and increasingly studied physiologically; no accepted evidence for perception without brain function
testable_prediction: Hidden-target studies in resuscitation rooms should yield verified perception if the experience is veridical; results so far are null or ambiguous
key_evidence_or_cases: AWARE and AWARE-II studies; Borjigin rat gamma surge 2013 and human dying-brain EEG 2022-2023; Pam Reynolds case (contested)
implication_if_solved: Would clarify what the dying brain does and inform resuscitation medicine

locus: India Lebanon Sri Lanka Turkey and US cases
observation_summary: Some young children make detailed statements about a previous life that researchers report matching a deceased stranger, sometimes with corresponding birthmarks
why_it_resists_explanation: Investigations usually begin after the family has already identified a candidate previous personality, allowing contamination; cultural expectation shapes reports; the strongest cases are not prospectively documented
leading_hypotheses: Social and family transmission of information plus cryptomnesia; investigator and recall bias; coincidence in loosely specified matches; actual survival and rebirth (not accepted scientifically)
mainstream_view: Not accepted by mainstream science; the case collections are regarded as methodologically unable to exclude normal information transfer
testable_prediction: Fully prospective documentation of statements before any candidate is identified, then blind matching
key_evidence_or_cases: Stevenson 2500 case files; James Leininger case; Tucker follow-up research
implication_if_solved: Would overturn the standard view of personal identity if ever demonstrated

observation_summary: Meta-analyses of sensory-deprivation telepathy experiments report hit rates slightly above the 25 percent chance baseline
why_it_resists_explanation: Effect sizes are small, replication across labs is inconsistent, and significance depends on which studies are included and on publication-bias corrections
leading_hypotheses: A genuine small anomalous information transfer; publication bias and selective reporting; sensory leakage and randomization flaws; questionable research practices inflating small effects
mainstream_view: Not accepted as evidence of psi; the mainstream reading is that the effect dissolves under preregistration and bias correction
testable_prediction: Large preregistered multi-lab adversarial collaborations should show whether any effect survives
key_evidence_or_cases: Honorton-Hyman joint communique 1986; autoganzfeld studies; Storm and Tressoldi meta-analyses; Milton and Wiseman null meta-analysis 1999
implication_if_solved: Would require fundamental revision of information physics if real

phenomenon: Remote viewing and the Stargate program
observation_summary: Two decades of government-funded studies reported some viewers describing distant sites at better than chance, leading to a 20-year classified program
why_it_resists_explanation: Judging procedures allowed cueing, sessions were analyzed post hoc, and the AIR review found no operational utility despite statistical anomalies in some studies
leading_hypotheses: Subtle cueing and judging artifacts; statistical analysis flaws; selective reporting of successes; a small genuine anomaly (minority position)
mainstream_view: The 1995 American Institutes for Research evaluation concluded the effect was not demonstrated and had no intelligence value; program terminated
testable_prediction: Blinded preregistered trials with independent judging have not produced reliable effects
key_evidence_or_cases: SRI experiments; Stargate declassified files 1995; AIR report by Utts and Hyman with opposite conclusions
implication_if_solved: Would be an enormous practical and theoretical discovery if real

locus: Worldwide network of random number generators
observation_summary: The project reports small deviations in networked random number generator output correlated with globally attention-grabbing events
why_it_resists_explanation: Event selection and timing windows were often determined with knowledge of the data, and the cumulative statistic is sensitive to analysis choices
leading_hypotheses: Post hoc event selection and flexible analysis producing spurious cumulative deviation; environmental and hardware effects on generators; a genuine consciousness-matter interaction (not accepted)
mainstream_view: Not accepted by mainstream statisticians; criticized for analytic flexibility and lack of preregistration
testable_prediction: Fully preregistered event definitions and windows announced before events occur
key_evidence_or_cases: GCP cumulative deviation plots; September 11 2001 analysis; independent critiques by Scargle and others
implication_if_solved: Would indicate an unknown coupling between mental states and physical randomness

observation_summary: Some studies report physiological or behavioral responses occurring before randomly selected stimuli are presented
why_it_resists_explanation: The flagship 2011 result failed to replicate in large preregistered attempts and the original analyses had multiple flexible choices
leading_hypotheses: Expectancy bias and nonrandom stimulus sequences; multiple comparisons and optional stopping; physiological baseline drift artifacts; genuine retrocausal information flow (not accepted)
mainstream_view: Widely regarded as a demonstration of how flexible analysis produces false positives; Bem 2011 catalyzed the replication crisis reforms
testable_prediction: Large preregistered replications, which have been run and were null
key_evidence_or_cases: Bem 2011 Journal of Personality and Social Psychology; Ritchie Wiseman French 2012 failed replication; Mossbridge presentiment meta-analysis
implication_if_solved: Would overturn causality if real; already highly influential in reforming psychology methods

phenomenon: Decline effect in parapsychology and beyond
observation_summary: Reported effect sizes in parapsychology and in many other fields shrink as experiments are repeated and tightened
why_it_resists_explanation: Multiple mechanisms produce the pattern, and distinguishing genuine decline from statistical regression requires preregistration that was historically absent
leading_hypotheses: Regression to the mean after initially overestimated effects; publication bias; progressive tightening of controls removing artifacts; questionable research practices; genuine elusiveness of the phenomenon (parapsychologists)
mainstream_view: Now largely understood as a metascience and statistics phenomenon rather than evidence of elusive effects
testable_prediction: Preregistered replication series should show stable effect sizes when the underlying effect is real
key_evidence_or_cases: Rhine card experiments decline; Ioannidis analyses; Many Labs replication projects
implication_if_solved: Explains a broad pattern across all of empirical science

phenomenon: Marfa lights and similar spook lights
locus: Marfa Texas Brown Mountain North Carolina Hessdalen Norway Min Min Australia
observation_summary: Mysterious lights appear repeatedly in specific locations, moving, splitting and changing color, documented for over a century at some sites
why_it_resists_explanation: Many sites have been shown to involve distant headlights seen through atmospheric layers, but a minority of observations predate automobiles and remain unexplained
leading_hypotheses: Atmospheric refraction and mirage of distant vehicle and town lights (demonstrated at Marfa and Brown Mountain); Fata Morgana superior mirages; piezoelectric or ionized gas discharge at tectonically active sites (Hessdalen); bioluminescence or swamp gas; some reports are observational error
mainstream_view: Most well-studied cases resolve to mirage and vehicle lights; the Hessdalen lights remain partially unexplained with instrumented data
testable_prediction: Simultaneous triangulated observation with spectroscopy should identify emitting species or confirm refraction
key_evidence_or_cases: SMU student headlight correlation study at Marfa 2004; USGS Brown Mountain studies; Project Hessdalen instrumented station
implication_if_solved: Would complete the physics of recurring atmospheric light displays

observation_summary: Pale flickering flames reported over wetlands for centuries, now rarely seen
why_it_resists_explanation: Reports declined sharply with wetland drainage before modern instrumentation, so the phenomenon was never measured
leading_hypotheses: Spontaneous ignition of phosphine and diphosphane with methane from decaying organic matter; cold flame chemiluminescence; bioluminescent fungi misidentified; some reports being mirage or folklore
mainstream_view: Considered a real historical phenomenon of marsh gas chemistry; mechanism never confirmed experimentally in the field
testable_prediction: Laboratory reproduction of a persistent cool flame from marsh gas mixtures at ambient conditions
key_evidence_or_cases: Historical accounts across Europe; laboratory phosphine ignition demonstrations; absence of modern field measurements
implication_if_solved: Would resolve a folklore phenomenon with ordinary chemistry

locus: Mouth of the Catatumbo River Venezuela
observation_summary: The highest lightning density on Earth, with near-nightly storms up to 300 nights a year and hundreds of flashes per hour in one small area
why_it_resists_explanation: Why this particular basin sustains such extreme and regular convection involves a specific interaction of terrain, lake breeze and methane that is only partly modeled
leading_hypotheses: Topographic convergence of trade winds in the Lake Maracaibo basin with persistent moisture supply; methane from oil fields and wetlands enhancing charge separation (contested); nocturnal low-level jet forcing
mainstream_view: Accepted as an extreme but explicable mesoscale phenomenon; the methane contribution is disputed
testable_prediction: High-resolution modeling should reproduce the diurnal and seasonal cycle without invoking methane
key_evidence_or_cases: Lightning Imaging Sensor global maps; Albrecht et al 2016 ranking it the top hotspot
implication_if_solved: Would refine understanding of extreme convective systems

observation_summary: A small fraction of lightning flashes are 100 to 1000 times more energetic than typical, concentrated over the Mediterranean North Atlantic and Altiplano
why_it_resists_explanation: The physical reason that a few discharges release so much more energy is not established, and detection depends on method
leading_hypotheses: Short cloud-to-ground distance in shallow charge-layer storms; warm sea surface with high cloud base; specific charge-structure geometry
mainstream_view: Real and now well mapped; the mechanism is being narrowed
testable_prediction: Charge structure soundings in superbolt-prone storms should show the predicted geometry
key_evidence_or_cases: Vela satellite optical detections 1977; 2019-2023 WWLLN and GLM superbolt climatologies
implication_if_solved: Would complete the energy distribution theory of lightning

observation_summary: Red sprites, blue jets, elves and gigantic jets occur tens of kilometers above storms, dismissed as pilot error for a century until photographed in 1989
why_it_resists_explanation: They last milliseconds at altitudes inaccessible to most instruments; the detailed streamer initiation physics is still being worked out
leading_hypotheses: Quasi-electrostatic field after a large positive cloud-to-ground stroke driving streamer discharge in rarefied air; electromagnetic pulse heating for elves
mainstream_view: Fully accepted and actively researched; initiation details and chemical effects on the mesosphere are open
testable_prediction: High-speed imaging should resolve streamer inception altitudes predicted by quasi-electrostatic models
key_evidence_or_cases: Franz 1989 accidental video; ISS and ASIM observations; Pasko modeling
implication_if_solved: Would complete the electrical circuit model of the atmosphere

observation_summary: Large numbers of people confidently share identical false memories of logos, film lines and spellings
why_it_resists_explanation: Why specific errors converge across unrelated people requires explaining shared schema formation, and not all cases have an identified cause
leading_hypotheses: Schema-driven reconstruction producing the same most-plausible error; visual and semantic gist memory; social contagion and internet amplification; the visual Mandela effect shown experimentally to occur even for novel first exposures
mainstream_view: Explained as normal reconstructive memory plus social amplification; the convergence is itself a real and studied effect
testable_prediction: Lab studies show consistent false recall for specific icons in naive participants, which has been demonstrated
key_evidence_or_cases: Prasad and Bainbridge 2022 visual Mandela effect experiments; Monopoly man monocle; Berenstain Bears spelling
implication_if_solved: Already clarifies how memory reconstructs rather than records

phenomenon: Miracle of the Sun at Fatima
observation_summary: Tens of thousands of people reported the sun dancing, spinning or changing color at a predicted time; accounts vary widely and nearby observatories recorded nothing
why_it_resists_explanation: Reports are inconsistent with each other, no instrument recorded any solar change, and a sun-staring crowd under high expectation is a strong confound
leading_hypotheses: Retinal afterimages and phosphene artifacts from staring at the sun; sundog or ice-crystal optical effect through thin cloud; mass suggestion and expectation in a primed crowd; a genuine miracle (theological not scientific claim)
mainstream_view: Treated as a psychological and optical phenomenon; no physical solar event occurred
testable_prediction: Any solar change would have been visible globally and recorded, and was not
key_evidence_or_cases: Contemporary newspaper accounts; absence of any astronomical record; witness testimony variability
implication_if_solved: Would document a reference case of mass perceptual experience

observation_summary: Statues and icons appear to shed tears, oil or blood, drawing large crowds and occasional church investigation
why_it_resists_explanation: Many cases are never examined by independent investigators before being cleaned or venerated, so evidence disappears
leading_hypotheses: Deliberate application of oil or blood by a person; capillary action and condensation in porous plaster drawing moisture; hydrophilic glaze absorbing then weeping water; investigated cases have repeatedly found human blood or oil of local origin
mainstream_view: Investigated cases have overwhelmingly been found to involve human intervention or ordinary physics; some remain unexamined
testable_prediction: Immediate forensic sampling and DNA testing identifies the source, and has in several cases
key_evidence_or_cases: Civitavecchia statue 1995 with human blood of unidentified male; Syracuse Madonna 1953; Nickell investigations
implication_if_solved: Would reduce the recurrence of a specific class of pious fraud

locus: Tibetan practitioners and Wim Hof method practitioners
observation_summary: Trained practitioners raise peripheral and core temperature and modulate inflammatory response voluntarily through breathing and meditation
why_it_resists_explanation: Mechanistic studies are small, confounded by cold-adaptation and hyperventilation effects, and the ceiling of the effect is not established
leading_hypotheses: Forced breathing-induced respiratory alkalosis plus sympathetic catecholamine surge suppressing cytokine release; brown adipose tissue activation; intercostal muscle thermogenesis; placebo and training effects on cold tolerance
mainstream_view: The immune modulation has been shown in a randomized endotoxin trial; the physiology is partly understood and not considered supernatural
testable_prediction: Replication with larger samples and controlled breathing-only arms should isolate the mechanism
key_evidence_or_cases: Benson 1982 Tibetan monk measurements; Kox et al 2014 PNAS endotoxin trial; brown fat PET imaging
implication_if_solved: Would give voluntary control over inflammation a clinical pathway

observation_summary: Extraordinary calculation, memory, musical or artistic abilities appear in some autistic individuals and occasionally emerge suddenly after brain injury or dementia onset
why_it_resists_explanation: Cases are rare and individual; no intervention reliably produces the abilities, and the neural changes are inferred not observed in real time
leading_hypotheses: Paradoxical functional facilitation from left anterior temporal inhibition releasing right-hemisphere capacity; privileged access to lower-level perceptual detail; rewiring and recruitment after injury; intense practice with unusual attention allocation
mainstream_view: Phenomenon fully accepted and documented; mechanism partially mapped and not reproducible on demand
testable_prediction: Transcranial stimulation of the left anterior temporal lobe should transiently enhance specific skills, with weak and contested results so far
key_evidence_or_cases: Kim Peek; Derek Amato acquired musical savantism; Orlando Serrell; Snyder TMS studies
implication_if_solved: Would reveal latent capacities in all human brains

phenomenon: Hyperthymesia and highly superior autobiographical memory
observation_summary: Some people can recall almost every day of their adult life in detail, verified against records, with no corresponding advantage on standard memory tests
why_it_resists_explanation: The ability is domain-specific and the structural brain differences found are correlational; no training reproduces it
leading_hypotheses: Obsessive rehearsal and time-indexed retrieval strategy; enlarged temporal and parietal structural differences; unusual striatal-OCD-like circuitry; a combination of attention and rehearsal
mainstream_view: Accepted and verified; mechanism unexplained and the ability is not trainable
testable_prediction: Longitudinal imaging should distinguish cause from consequence of the rehearsal habit
key_evidence_or_cases: Jill Price case 2006; McGaugh HSAM cohort; structural MRI differences; false-memory susceptibility studies showing normal rates
implication_if_solved: Would show whether autobiographical memory capacity is a strategy or a structure

locus: A few percent of the population
observation_summary: Some people report no voluntary visual imagery at all while others report photographic vividness, with objective correlates confirming the difference
why_it_resists_explanation: Imagery is inherently private, so objective markers were only recently developed, and the cause of the variation is unknown
leading_hypotheses: Reduced top-down feedback from frontoparietal to visual cortex; differences in imagery metacognition rather than imagery itself; genetic and developmental variation
mainstream_view: Accepted as a genuine cognitive variation since objective binocular-rivalry priming and pupillometry confirmations
testable_prediction: Priming and pupil response measures should track self-reported vividness, and they do
key_evidence_or_cases: Galton 1880 breakfast table survey; Zeman 2015 aphantasia coinage; Keogh and Pearson binocular rivalry priming; pupillary light response to imagined brightness
implication_if_solved: Would ground the measurement of subjective experience in objective markers

observation_summary: A compelling sense of familiarity for a situation known to be novel, often with simultaneous awareness that the feeling is wrong
why_it_resists_explanation: The experience is brief, unpredictable and rarely captured in a scanner except in epilepsy, where it may differ from the healthy version
leading_hypotheses: Brief mismatch between familiarity and recollection systems in medial temporal lobe; rhinal cortex misfiring; dual-processing timing error; partial gestalt familiarity from configural overlap (induced in lab via Cleary paradigms)
mainstream_view: Now reproducibly induced in the lab via configural similarity; the healthy spontaneous version is still not fully explained
testable_prediction: Lab-induced deja vu should show the same neural signature as spontaneous reports
key_evidence_or_cases: Temporal lobe epilepsy aura reports; Cleary virtual-tour induction studies; depth electrode stimulation of rhinal cortex
implication_if_solved: Would clarify the architecture of familiarity and recollection

observation_summary: Dozens to hundreds of people danced uncontrollably for days to weeks, some reportedly until collapse or death
why_it_resists_explanation: Records are sparse and secondhand, and modern diagnostic categories map poorly onto 16th century accounts
leading_hypotheses: Mass psychogenic illness in a famine-stressed, religiously primed population; ergot alkaloid poisoning from rye (unlikely to produce coordinated dancing); a culturally scripted trance ritual
mainstream_view: Generally read as mass psychogenic illness shaped by local St Vitus beliefs
testable_prediction: Comparable modern outbreaks follow similar stress-plus-script patterns, which they do
key_evidence_or_cases: Strasbourg municipal records; parallel outbreaks in the Rhine valley; Tanganyika laughter epidemic 1962 as a modern analogue
implication_if_solved: Would deepen understanding of culturally shaped mass illness

observation_summary: About a million people developed a devastating sleeping sickness with post-encephalitic parkinsonism, then the epidemic vanished and never recurred at scale
why_it_resists_explanation: No pathogen was ever isolated, preserved tissue is scarce and degraded, and the epidemic ended before modern virology existed
leading_hypotheses: A then-unknown enterovirus; autoimmune reaction to streptococcal infection (basal ganglia antibodies found in modern sporadic cases); an influenza-related complication (largely discounted by timing); a virus that no longer circulates
mainstream_view: Genuine unexplained epidemic; recent work favors a post-infectious autoimmune mechanism
testable_prediction: Metagenomic sequencing of archived brain tissue could identify a pathogen; attempts so far have been negative for influenza
key_evidence_or_cases: von Economo 1917 description; Oliver Sacks Awakenings patients; McCall influenza RNA negative studies; Dale basal ganglia antibodies
implication_if_solved: Would identify a pathogen capable of causing mass neurological injury

locus: US diplomatic personnel in Havana Beijing and elsewhere
observation_summary: Personnel reported sudden onset of directional noise or pressure, followed by vertigo, cognitive difficulty and persistent symptoms
why_it_resists_explanation: No device or energy signature was ever detected, imaging findings conflict between studies, and the population is small and self-selected
leading_hypotheses: Pulsed radiofrequency or microwave energy (Frey effect) from a directed device; ultrasonic interference; functional neurological disorder with social transmission; pre-existing conditions plus heightened attention; crickets misidentified in at least one audio recording
mainstream_view: The 2023 US intelligence community assessment found it very unlikely that a foreign adversary is responsible; 2024 NIH studies found no consistent brain injury, while some earlier studies reported differences
testable_prediction: A specific device and energy signature would need to be detected or demonstrated to reproduce the symptom profile
key_evidence_or_cases: 2018 JAMA imaging study; 2020 NASEM report favoring directed RF; 2024 NIH JAMA studies finding no MRI differences; 2023 ODNI assessment
implication_if_solved: Would resolve a major diplomatic and medical controversy

locus: Self-identified patients mostly in the US
observation_summary: Patients report fibers emerging from skin lesions with crawling sensations and systemic symptoms
why_it_resists_explanation: Patient-collected samples are contaminated with environmental fibers, and the condition was defined by patients online before any clinical study
leading_hypotheses: Delusional infestation with self-excoriation and textile fiber contamination (CDC conclusion); association with Borrelia infection (claimed by a minority, not replicated); an unrecognized disease
mainstream_view: The 2012 CDC study found no infectious cause and fibers consistent with cotton; mainstream dermatology classifies it as delusional infestation
testable_prediction: Blinded analysis of lesion-derived material should show textile fibers, and did
key_evidence_or_cases: CDC multisite study 2012; Pearson et al fiber analysis; Middelveen Borrelia claims
implication_if_solved: Would redirect care toward effective psychiatric and dermatologic treatment

observation_summary: All nontrivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function appear to lie on the critical line, verified for over ten trillion zeros but unproven
why_it_resists_explanation: No method connects the analytic properties of zeta to a structure strong enough to force the zeros onto the line; it may require entirely new mathematics
leading_hypotheses: Spectral interpretation via a self-adjoint operator (Hilbert-Polya); random matrix theory connections; function field analogues proven by Weil and Deligne pointing the way; proof remains absent
mainstream_view: Clay Millennium Prize problem; widely believed true
testable_prediction: A counterexample zero off the line would disprove it instantly
key_evidence_or_cases: Numerical verification of 10^13 zeros; Montgomery pair correlation matching GUE statistics; proven function-field analogue
implication_if_solved: Would pin down the distribution of prime numbers precisely

observation_summary: Nobody knows whether problems whose solutions are quickly checkable are also quickly solvable
why_it_resists_explanation: All known proof techniques are blocked by formal barriers: relativization, natural proofs and algebrization
leading_hypotheses: P does not equal NP (overwhelming expert belief); P equals NP; the question is independent of standard axioms
mainstream_view: Clay Millennium Prize problem; central open question of computer science
testable_prediction: A polynomial algorithm for any NP-complete problem, or a superpolynomial lower bound, settles it
key_evidence_or_cases: Cook-Levin theorem; thousands of NP-complete problems; Razborov-Rudich natural proofs barrier
implication_if_solved: Would transform cryptography optimization and the limits of knowledge itself

observation_summary: Repeatedly halving even numbers and tripling-plus-one odd numbers appears to always reach 1, verified to about 2.95 x 10^20 with no proof
why_it_resists_explanation: The dynamics mix multiplicative and additive structure, which no current technique handles; Conway showed a generalized version is undecidable
leading_hypotheses: The conjecture is true; a divergent trajectory or long cycle exists; the problem is undecidable in a relevant generalized form
mainstream_view: Famously resistant; Erdos said mathematics is not yet ready for it
testable_prediction: Tao proved almost all orbits reach almost bounded values, the strongest partial result
key_evidence_or_cases: Exhaustive computational verification; Tao 2019 almost-all result; Conway FRACTRAN undecidability
implication_if_solved: Would likely require a new technique for mixing arithmetic dynamics

observation_summary: Primes appear to come in infinitely many pairs differing by two, and every even number above two appears to be a sum of two primes
why_it_resists_explanation: Sieve methods have a parity obstruction that blocks the final step; the problems demand control over primes beyond current methods
leading_hypotheses: Both conjectures are true; proof requires breakthroughs in sieve theory or in understanding prime correlations
mainstream_view: Both strongly believed true with major partial progress
testable_prediction: Zhang and Maynard reduced the prime gap bound to 246; Helfgott proved the ternary Goldbach conjecture
key_evidence_or_cases: Zhang 2013 bounded gaps; Polymath8 and Maynard; Helfgott ternary Goldbach 2013; Goldbach verified to 4 x 10^18
implication_if_solved: Would represent a leap in understanding the additive structure of primes

observation_summary: Abstract mathematics developed for internal reasons repeatedly turns out to describe physical reality with extraordinary precision
why_it_resists_explanation: Any explanation must address whether mathematics is discovered or invented, which is not empirically decidable
leading_hypotheses: Mathematical universe hypothesis (Tegmark); selection effect in which we only notice the mathematics that works; mathematics as the abstraction of physical regularity; evolutionary tuning of human cognition to the environment
mainstream_view: A genuine puzzle noted by physicists; no scientific resolution available
testable_prediction: No clean empirical test exists, which is part of the problem
key_evidence_or_cases: Group theory predicting particle families; complex analysis in quantum mechanics; non-Euclidean geometry predating general relativity
implication_if_solved: Would clarify the relationship between mathematics and physical reality

phenomenon: Why there is something rather than nothing
observation_summary: The universe exists with specific laws rather than nothing existing at all, and no framework explains why
why_it_resists_explanation: Any explanatory law or mechanism would itself be something requiring explanation, making the question possibly structurally unanswerable
leading_hypotheses: Quantum vacuum instability making nothing unstable; necessary existence of mathematical structures; brute fact; the question is malformed because nothing is not a coherent alternative
mainstream_view: Generally considered outside empirical science, though cosmologists sometimes address a weaker version
testable_prediction: No test is currently conceivable
key_evidence_or_cases: Hartle-Hawking no-boundary proposal; Vilenkin tunneling from nothing; Krauss vacuum arguments
implication_if_solved: Would be the deepest possible explanatory achievement

observation_summary: In a universe that lasts long enough, random fluctuations should produce vastly more isolated conscious observers than evolved ones, making our ordered experience statistically bizarre
why_it_resists_explanation: The problem depends on the measure used to count observers in an infinite universe, and no agreed measure exists
leading_hypotheses: Our universe decays before Boltzmann brains dominate; the correct cosmological measure suppresses them; de Sitter space does not actually produce them; the problem signals an error in the eternal inflation framework
mainstream_view: Treated as a genuine consistency constraint on cosmological models
testable_prediction: Models that predict Boltzmann brain domination are considered falsified by our own ordered observations
key_evidence_or_cases: de Sitter fluctuation rate calculations; eternal inflation measure proposals
implication_if_solved: Would constrain which cosmological models are self-consistent

observation_summary: In an infinite multiverse, probabilities depend on how one counts regions, and different cutoffs give wildly different predictions
why_it_resists_explanation: Infinite volumes require a regularization choice with no physical principle to select one
leading_hypotheses: Scale factor cutoff; causal patch measure; light-cone time cutoff; the multiverse framework is wrong
mainstream_view: Recognized as a severe problem for making any prediction from eternal inflation
testable_prediction: Different measures predict different observed cosmological constants and curvature
key_evidence_or_cases: Youngness paradox; predictions of the cosmological constant from various measures
implication_if_solved: Would make multiverse cosmology predictive rather than unfalsifiable

observation_summary: Humans have a combinatorially unbounded communication system with no graded intermediate in any other living species
why_it_resists_explanation: Language leaves no direct fossil record, the relevant genetic changes are unknown, and the Paris Linguistic Society famously banned the topic as unanswerable
leading_hypotheses: Gradual evolution from gestural and vocal precursors; a single recent mutation enabling recursive merge (Chomsky and Berwick); cultural ratchet with coevolution of brain and language; protolanguage of holistic calls
mainstream_view: Active field with no consensus; evidence is inherently indirect
testable_prediction: Genomic comparison with Neanderthals plus vocal tract reconstruction constrains timing but not mechanism
key_evidence_or_cases: FOXP2 variants; Neanderthal hyoid bone; symbolic artifacts; absence of recursive syntax in trained apes
implication_if_solved: Would explain the single trait most responsible for human dominance

observation_summary: Writing was invented independently at least three or four times, and never arose in many other complex societies
why_it_resists_explanation: The earliest stages are preserved only in durable media, and diffusion versus independence is hard to prove for Egypt
leading_hypotheses: Administrative accounting pressure in state formation driving invention; stimulus diffusion from Mesopotamia to Egypt; independent invention in each case
mainstream_view: Mesopotamian, Chinese and Mesoamerican independence is accepted; Egyptian independence is debated
testable_prediction: Earlier proto-writing finds should show a continuous local development sequence
key_evidence_or_cases: Uruk clay tokens and tablets; Abydos labels; Oracle bone script; Zapotec and Maya glyphs
